# Security GRC Analyst

**Role specifics**

* Salary range: £60,000 – 70,000
* Reporting to: Chief Information Officer
* Key stakeholders: Platform and Development, Product, Sales and Onboarding, IT Operations, Legal Counsel and DPO, People team, our managed security operations provider, customer security and assurance teams
* Organisational Framework Level: Level 3 – Professional Specialist
* Eligible to obtain UK security clearance (SC). UK-based.
* Minimum requirement of 2 days per week in our Bristol office

**About you/ Job Summary**

As a Security Governance, Risk and Compliance Analyst, you keep our information security management system current, evidenced and moving. Clue supplies software to UK public sector, Sports and law enforcement, and those customers expect us to show, not just say, that our controls work. You will administer our ISO 27001 ISMS day to day, maintain the risk register, lead customer security assurance, run the supplier assessment cycle and coordinate the record-keeping and communications when an incident occurs. The CISO leads the security function, sets direction, and holds accountability; the Security Engineering team and IT own the technical controls. Your job is to do the work between them intelligently: know where every piece of evidence lives, what we have promised each customer, what is due next, and who needs chasing.

At Clue we are actively adopting AI to improve our products and workflows. You will bring curiosity and a willingness to use AI tools to work faster and more accurately, while knowing where they should not be trusted.

**Key Accountabilities**

**ISMS and certification**

• Administer the information security policy, set: review schedule, publication and acknowledgement records, with the CISO approving changes.

• Maintain ISO 27001:2022 certification: statement of applicability, evidence library, internal audit scheduling and external audit coordination.

• Work with IT to maintain security accreditations such as Cyber Essentials Plus and our ISO accreditations, plus the evidence set for the NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework where customers require it.

• Maintain the security exceptions register, tracking time-limited approvals and named risk sponsors.

• Pen-test and crisis simulation exercise management and coordination, alongside the CISO.

**Risk management**

• Maintain the risk register and apply the scoring model set by the CISO. Keep entries current, sponsored and treated.

• Prepare and coordinate the monthly risk register review with executive risk sponsors, and track treatment plans to closure.

• Draft register entries from audit findings, incident lessons, threat assessments and customer requirements, for CISO review, each with a proposed owner.

• Maintain the list of security-related product roadmap requests and coordinate prioritisation between the CISO and Product.

**Customer assurance and contractual compliance**

• Lead customer security assurance: draft questionnaire responses, assemble evidence packs and handle due diligence requests, drawing technical input from the DevSecOps Engineer and IT Operations.

• Maintain the single record of every security commitment made to a customer.

• Carry out compliance checks of customer environments before go-live and report the results to the CISO for sign-off.

• Track our obligations under CCS framework security schedules and G-Cloud 15 Call-Off Schedule 9A, and maintain the evidence for each.

• Produce customer-facing assurance reporting, including the monthly vulnerability report within five working days of month end.

**Security operations governance**

• Coordinate the day-to-day relationship with our managed security operations provider: track service levels, prepare monthly service reviews and maintain the detection improvement backlog.

• Track vulnerability remediation against contractual windows, record exceptions and report performance.

• Maintain the protective monitoring standard and the logging and monitoring evidence an assurance review will test.

• Keep a record of threat intelligence intake from NCSC and other sources, and of the actions taken.

**Incident management**

• Act as incident coordinator: convene the response channel, keep the record, apply the severity matrix and escalation path without discretion, and track actions to closure. The CISO chairs incidents and coordinates Clue response.

• Prepare and track customer and regulatory notifications, including any contractual out of hours customer notification and the UK GDPR 72-hour ICO window, with Legal and the DPO.

• Maintain the incident register, organise post-incident reviews and track corrective actions.

• Maintain the annualcrisis exercise plan and organise the exercises.

**Third-party risk management**

• Operate the supplier assurance process and platform: onboard, tier and reassess suppliers on a risk-based cycle.

• Keep a named executive sponsor recorded for each material supplier and chase their review obligations.

**People, access and awareness**

• Draft security awareness and training requirements and assure delivery with the People team.

• Support the People Director with the vetting policy and collect the evidence that personnel security controls operate.

• Collect and check access governance evidence: review schedules, privileged access records and joiner, mover and leaver records.

• Support the Security Champions network with process guidance.

**Governance and reporting**

• Organise the governance cadence: weekly security governance, fortnightly Security Steering Group, monthly risk review and quarterly Information Security Management Forum. Agendas, papers, minutes and actions.

• Draft sponsor and board-level reporting for the CISO, sourced and consistent across documents.

• Track every security action to a named owner and a date, and report status without spin.

**Key role measures**

* ISO 27001 certification maintained with no major nonconformities; audit findings closed within agreed date
* Risk register currency: every entry reviewed within its cycle, sponsored, and with a live treatment plan
* Customer assurance turnaround: questionnaires and evidence requests answered within agreed SLAs with no unsupported commitments
* Vulnerability remediation reported accurately against contractual windows, with exceptions recorded
* Incident notifications made within contractual and regulatory windows; post-incident actions closed
* Supplier coverage: all material suppliers tiered, assessed and sponsored

**Experience and skills**

**Our ideal candidate would have experience in the following areas:**

**Information security management**

* Working within an ISO 27001 ISMS through certification or surveillance audits, ideally in a SaaS organisation.
* Maintaining a risk register and working with senior risk owners to keep entries current and treated.
* Keeping exceptions, policies and evidence to an audit-ready standard.

**Customer and public sector assurance**

* Responding to customer security questionnaires and due diligence, ideally for UK public sector customers.
* Working knowledge of CCS framework security schedules, G-Cloud Schedule 9A, Cyber Essentials Plus and the NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework.
* Good understanding of data protection and UK GDPR, including Articles 28 and 33.

**Supplier and service governance**

* Tracking a managed service or supplier against contract and service levels and preparing service reviews.
* Third-party risk management, including experience of a TPRM platform (desirable).

• Incident management

* Coordinating security incidents, keeping records and preparing customer or regulatory notifications.

**Technical literacy**

* Enough understanding of cloud, SIEM and vulnerability management to read a service report or scan output and ask the right questions. You will not be writing detection rules.

**Communication and ways of working**

* Clear, precise written English. Your reports and evidence will be read by customers, auditors and executives.
* Organised and self-directed, able to keep several governance cycles moving in parallel and chase others to dates politely and persistently.

**Qualifications**

* ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CISM, CRISC, CISMP or equivalent (desirable).  
    
  **Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**

  If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us more about yourself. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

  We believe that seeing the world from all sorts of angles makes life better for all. We want you to know that the things that make you an individual, like your identity, age, ethnicity, religion, ability and background, are things that we choose to celebrate and support.

  We are a scale-up company, and as we continue to grow, we are passionate that having a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace will remain at our core. We are creating an inclusive environment where our people can thrive.

  Our values are aligned and at the heart of everything we do. We are respectful, united, rigorous, relentless and ethical.

# D365 CE & Power Platform Technical Support Team Lead

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced D365 CE & Power Platform Technical Support Team Lead to join our team.  The successful candidate will lead a team of L2 and L3 technical consultants who provide application support, troubleshooting, and enhancements for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) solutions and the wider Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse). The candidate would be expected to be hands-on with incident resolution and change delivery alongside their team management responsibilities.

From a technical perspective, this role involves working closely with business users, internal teams, and third-party vendors to ensure smooth system operations, timely resolution of incidents, and the ongoing optimization of CRM and Power Platform solutions. You will also work as an escalation point across the Power Platform support practice helping your colleagues resolve incidents and deliver more technical changes.

In terms of leadership, you will be responsible for the performance of your team and the quality of their delivery and ticket management. You will be expected to lead daily stand ups and undertake regular one to ones as well as semi-annual performance reviews with your team.

## Key Responsibilities

* Lead a team of D365 CE and Power Platform consultants.
* Own performance management and goal setting for your team.
* Champion best practise across the team, in terms of technical delivery and ticket management.
* Work alongside our Service Delivery and Change team to ensure priorities are managed and delivered.
* Work as a technical escalation point primarily for a sub-set of our customers but also across the wider team.
* Troubleshoot issues related to Dynamics 365 CE modules (Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, Field Service).
* Support and maintain Power Platform solutions including Canvas Apps, Model-driven Apps, Power Automate flows, Power BI reports, and Dataverse.
* Configuration and customisation of Dynamics 365 CE including Plugins, Javascripts, Web Services, Logic Apps, Azure Functions and Service Bus.
* Manage and coordinate system upgrades, Wave updates, and patch deployments, ensuring operational continuity and minimal disruption.
* Solution lifecycle management (DevOps, ALM).
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications or Change Requests.
* Manage and prioritise your time effectively.

## Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

* Proven experience leading and mentoring Dynamics 365 CE functional and technical consultants, within an L2/L3 support or managed services environment.
* Experience managing the day-to-day delivery of support services, ensuring SLAs, KPIs, service quality and customer satisfaction objectives are achieved.
* Proven ability to prioritise and coordinate multiple support activities, escalations and development initiatives across competing customer requirements.
* Proven experience conducting code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions and mentoring team members to support technical development and career progression.
* Experience collaborating with Service Delivery Managers, Customer Success teams and client stakeholders to provide technical guidance and strategic recommendations.
* Strong experience supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE (CRM) in a technical role.
* Experience creating plugins, Javascript and Azure function apps.
* Strong experience with the wider Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Power Pages).
* Expert knowledge of D365 CE modules such as Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, or Field Service.
* Experience integrating Dynamics CRM with 3*rd* party APIs and custom integrations.
* Microsoft certifications PL-200 and PL-400/600, other certifications are a plus.
* Experience working with DevOps, ALM processes, and CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform solutions.
* Knowledge of SQL data migration and reporting tools.
* Experience with Azure application services.

Established over 40 years ago, Codec is a multi-award-winning Microsoft Solutions Partner, trusted by public and private sector organisations to deliver impactful digital transformation. With offices in **Dublin**, **Belfast**, **Cologne**, and across **Germany**, our team of over **300 experts** specialises in harnessing the full potential of Microsoft technologies—including **Dynamics 365**, **Power Platform**, **Azure**, and **Copilot**—to drive innovation, automation, and operational excellence. Though originally best known as a hardware reseller, since 2010 Codec has focused on building an outstanding software consulting business with a team of experts implementing enterprise solutions using products from Microsoft and Oracle. Our team is a careful mix of recent graduates and experienced professionals from a variety of diverse cultural backgrounds. # Senior Cloud Native Security Engineer

London/Remote

**Report To:**Delivery Manager

**Job Location:** Remote and/or London (right to work in UK or EU required)

**Employment Status:** Full Time

# **Who is ControlPlane?**

ControlPlane is a London headquartered consultancy specialising in cloud-native, Kubernetes, and open source solutions. Our expertise lies in helping organisations adopt and secure complex cloud infrastructures by implementing security measures that are "secure-by-design" and "secure-by-default." This engineering excellence has driven ControlPlane deeper into cybersecurity providing services like threat modelling, penetration testing, and supply chain security to ensure robust protection against cyberattacks in containerised and cloud-native environments.

We are acclaimed for our contributions to securing highly regulated industries, such as finance, healthcare, and national infrastructure. We help businesses improve their security posture through services like DevSecOps consulting, zero-trust architectures, and platform engineering. ControlPlane also focuses on advancing best practices in the Kubernetes ecosystem, offering specialised training and community engagement.

Our clients range from multinational banks to tech giants and public clouds, where we assist with both security and operational needs. In addition to consulting, we are active in the open source community, supporting projects like Flux CD and providing security tools for Kubernetes environments.

Over the coming years you’ll see us retain our focus on solving difficult problems for clients with intense security controls using pragmatic, real world solutions. Taking our extensive R&D to help organisations consume next generation and open source projects safely and securely - that might be extending our work with FINOS AI Readiness or the overhaul of open source supply chain security.

## What We're Looking For in a Senior Cloud Native Security Consultant

We are looking for Senior Cloud Native Security consultants to represent the technical and cultural values of ControlPlane, leading our customers by example in the complex and fast-changing world of cloud native technology. You will perform a mix of client consulting, working on internal labs projects, and contributing to Open Source projects on ControlPlane’s behalf.

There is no perfect candidate for this role. As we look to extend our cloud native security team we welcome engineers and architects with a diverse range of capabilities, experiences and backgrounds.

We are SANS authors (SEC584) and believe strongly in team learning and collaboration. Candidates with an aptitude to learn are preferred, and we provide full training for the newest cloud technologies that our customers rely on.

This is a unique job role within a successful start-up company where you will have the chance to make a positive impact, learn, grow and work with great colleagues who consistently challenge the status quo.

## Roles, Responsibilities and Requirements of Our Senior Cloud Native Security Consultant:

* Experience of Threat Modelling and Cloud Native Security architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
* Kubernetes and container experience (some of EKS, GKE, AKS, OpenShift, and container runtimes)
* Experience of software supply chain security
* DevSecOps principles and Engineering practices
* Any Vault, service mesh, in-toto, Tekton Chains, SPIFFE, and/or Sigstore experience is a plus
* CI/CD experience, automating security tests, and hardening pipelines
* Knowledge of security tooling from enterprise tools such as Aqua, Prisma, Sysdig, Lacework, etc to Open Source tools such as falco, kube-hunter, and kube-bench.
* Knowledge and experience using hardening guides, compliance and risk management standards
* Security related qualifications such as OSCP, Cloud Provider Security certifications, or CISSP

# A desire to learn, or experience with:

* CLI tooling in any of the above technologies.
* Golang or Python
* Terraform and cloud infrastructure best practices (IaC, regulated systems)

## Benefits

ControlPlane is a dynamic, cutting edge and passionate business for which to work. Our employees are the heart of our business, which means we care about our company culture and our employees’ wellbeing and progression. Alongside this, as our colleague you will have the following benefits:

* Generous and competitive salary
* Bonus
* 33 days of paid holiday, including paid leave for the standard 8 UK Bank Holidays
* Enhanced Parental Leave
* Private Medical insurance

* An individual training budget for personal development, including but not limited to:

+ Conferences
+ Training (books, courses, coaching, as well as internal training which is of course included beyond budget)
+ Qualifications

We believe our peers are equally as important as the technology we use. We’re looking for people of the highest personal calibre, quietly confident, with a good work ethic, keenness to learn, emotional maturity and respect, who know that “we” is more than “me”, and who embrace human diversity of all kinds. As we grow you will help us to build a company culture of which we can all be proud. If you espouse these values, we want you!

**NOTE FOR RECRUITMENT AGENCIES:** Please do not call or email our team speculatively, we do not accept unsolicited CVs.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

CORE POWER was founded in 2018 to solve the world's energy challenges by delivering ship-based power directly to the industries and economies driving global prosperity, overcoming the barriers that have held nuclear energy back.

CORE POWER builds, integrates and deploys ship-based nuclear energy systems. We build and support two classes of vessel: moored ship-shaped power plants that generate high-density energy, and nuclear-powered commercial ships that will speed up global trade.

Headquartered in Chiswick, London, with offices in Washington, D.C. and Japan, CORE POWER operates at the intersection of advanced nuclear, maritime, energy security and industrial policy.

Role Summary

The Project Finance Analyst joins the Commercial Analytics team with a focus on the project financing and deal economics of floating nuclear power plants (FNPP) and commercial marine nuclear propulsion (CMNP). The role develops, builds and maintains the project finance models that define the economics of selling and deploying an FNPP/CMNP, covering SPV structures, offtake and PPA pricing, cash flows and project returns, and provides the economic analysis and costing support that feeds delivery programmes, including reactor and end user partnerships. The role also supports the evaluation of capital formation options for first-of-a-kind energy infrastructure, spanning equity, debt, export credit and government-backed financing, and the assessment of deployment opportunities for commercial and financial viability. As a pre-revenue, first-of-a-kind business, this analysis directly informs pricing, commercialisation strategy, business model development and investor engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Provides project finance modelling, deal economics and costing support across the Analytics portfolio, alongside broader economic assessment covering market and competitive cost positioning, policy and incentive impacts, and business model economics, always with a commercial focus. Works closely with the Director of Analytics, the Commercial team, programme leads and external partners to ensure the economics of FNPP and CMNP deployment are rigorously modelled, transparently documented and ready for commercial and investor use.

Job Requirements

Project Finance Modelling & Deal Economics:

* Builds and maintains project finance models for FNPP and CMNP deployments, covering SPV structures, capital structure/stack and gearing, cash flow and project returns (IRR, NPV, DSCR, payback).
* Models offtake and revenue structures, including PPA pricing, tolling, charter style and lease versus own arrangements, and how deal economics differ across end users (utilities, data centres, industrial off-takers, shipowners).
* Develops financing scenarios and sensitivity analysis across cost of capital, contract tenor, delivery risk, refuelling and refurbishment cycles, and residual value.
* Benchmarks structures, pricing and returns against comparable energy and infrastructure transactions and monitors relevant project finance market activity.
* Supports evaluation of capital formation and financing structures for first-of-a-kind deployment, including equity, debt, export credit agency and government-backed programmes, and what each implies for project bankability.
* Maintains model documentation, assumption registers and audit trails to investment-grade standards, ensuring models are review-ready for external scrutiny.

Economic Analysis & Programme Costing:

* Provides support to economic analysis and cost modelling feeding delivery programmes, including reactor vendor and end user collaboration projects.
* Supports bottom-up cost model development (cost to deliver), lifecycle cost analysis and LCOE/TCO assessment, integrating engineering inputs and partner data.
* Independently tests and challenges external cost estimates from partners and vendors.
* Translates techno-economic outputs into commercial implications such as pricing floors, margin structure, breakeven and bankability.

At Croud, we unlock potential by elevating our people, clients, and communities within a rapidly advancing and complex economy. Our culture is strategically driven and inspired by a shared long-term vision. It is collaborative and connected, with a focus on continuous learning and mutual support.

### ROLE OVERVIEW

---

As **Head of Compensation & Benefits (US & EMEA)**, you will be the strategic lead and operational owner of our total rewards strategy, employee benefits and payroll operations across North America and EMEA.

Reporting directly to the **CPO**, you will shape and deliver a globally aligned reward framework that supports our business strategy, attracts and retains world-class talent, and enables consistent, competitive and equitable reward practices across our markets.

The role combines strategic leadership across **job architecture, market benchmarking, salary structures and incentive design** with strong operational oversight. You will have accountability for the end-to-end payroll process, including final checks and sign-off on global payroll runs, ensuring accuracy, compliance and timely delivery.

You will also lead the selection and management of reward and payroll partners, ensuring robust governance and compliance with the legal and tax requirements of the jurisdictions in which we operate. Working closely with senior stakeholders across the business, you will bring together strategy, data and operational rigour to continuously evolve our compensation and benefits offering.

### RESPONSIBILITIES

---

#### **1. Strategic Reward & Compensation Planning**

* Design, implement, and govern market-competitive salary structures, bonus schemes, and incentive programs tailored across EMEA and US markets.
* Conduct annual global salary benchmarking, equity, and market adjustments using industry data (e.g., Mercer).
* Co-lead the annual performance, bonus and compensation review cycle, partner with Finance on budget allocation, and model scenario planning.
* Oversee job architecture, grading frameworks, and role evaluation systems across diverse regions.

#### **2. Benefits Management & Provider RFP**

* Evaluate, consolidate, and manage external benefits, health, wellness, and pension providers across US (e.g., 401(k), medical options) and EMEA locations.
* Lead RFP processes and contract negotiations to streamline multi-market benefits under unified, cost-effective vendors where appropriate.
* Monitor market practices to ensure regional benefits programs are competitive, inclusive, and compliant with local tax/legal mandates.

#### **3. Payroll Governance & Operational Oversight**

* Execute final checks and formal approval on monthly/bi-weekly multi-country payroll submissions prior to release, ensuring 100% accuracy and compliance.
* Manage third-party payroll providers across US and EMEA jurisdictions, establishing strict SLAs and performance benchmarks.
* Oversee payroll operations integration, standardising workflows and reducing manual intervention.

#### **4. Compliance, Tax & Risk Mitigation**

* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of US (Federal/State) and EMEA regional employment law, statutory tax requirements, and statutory benefits mandates.
* Manage statutory reward reporting processes with help of the People Operations Team, including mandatory disclosures (e.g., Gender Pay Gap reporting where applicable).
* Lead cross-functional alignment with Legal and Finance on tax, audit readiness, and risk management.

### PERSON SPECIFICATION

---

We’re looking for an experienced **Compensation & Benefits / Total Rewards leader** who can operate confidently at both strategic and operational levels. You’ll be comfortable shaping reward strategy for a complex, international organisation while also being hands-on enough to challenge the detail, spot risk and ensure our payroll and benefits operations are delivered accurately and effectively.

#### **Experience & Expertise**

* Significant experience in **Compensation & Benefits, Total Rewards or Reward leadership**, ideally within a complex, multi-country organisation.
* Strong experience designing and implementing **global or multi-market compensation frameworks**, including salary structures, job architecture, grading and benchmarking.
* Demonstrable experience managing **US and EMEA compensation and benefits**, with a strong understanding of the differences between markets and the ability to balance global consistency with local requirements.
* Strong knowledge of **market benchmarking, pay structures, incentive and bonus design**, and the use of external market data to inform reward decisions.
* Experience leading or significantly contributing to **annual compensation, bonus and performance review cycles**, including modelling budgets and scenarios in partnership with Finance.
* Proven experience managing **employee benefits programmes and providers**, including RFPs, contract negotiations, renewals and vendor performance.
* Strong understanding of **multi-country payroll operations and governance**, including experience managing third-party payroll providers and reviewing payroll outputs for accuracy and compliance.
* Good working knowledge of **US federal/state and EMEA employment, payroll, tax and statutory benefit requirements**, with the judgement to know when specialist Legal or tax advice is required.
* Experience working with **HRIS, payroll and reward technology**, with a track record of improving processes, data quality and automation.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders, including **C-suite and executive leadership**, and the confidence to provide clear, evidence-based recommendations on complex reward matters.

#### **Skills & Capabilities**

* **Strategic thinker:** able to translate business and people strategy into practical, scalable reward programmes.
* **Commercially astute:** understands the financial implications of reward decisions and can balance competitiveness, affordability and employee value.
* **Data-driven:** confident analysing market data, modelling scenarios and using insight to inform recommendations and decisions.
* **Operationally rigorous:** highly detail-oriented, with a strong focus on accuracy, governance, controls and risk management — particularly where payroll is concerned.
* **Strong communicator:** able to explain complex compensation, benefits, payroll and compliance matters clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences.
* **Influential partner:** builds trusted relationships with People, Finance, Legal and senior business leaders and can confidently challenge when required.
* **Problem solver:** comfortable navigating ambiguity, resolving complex issues and finding pragmatic solutions across different markets.
* **Change-oriented:** able to simplify, standardise and improve processes while recognising where local market requirements need to be retained.
* **Highly organised:** able to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, vendors and stakeholders across different countries without losing sight of the detail.
* **Discreet and trusted:** demonstrates sound judgement when handling highly confidential employee, salary and business information.

#### **What would make you stand out**

* Experience in a **high-growth, international or PE-backed organisation** where reward frameworks and processes are evolving.
* Experience bringing together or harmonising **different reward, benefits or payroll approaches following organisational change, acquisition or international expansion**.
* Experience working within a **professional services, agency, technology or similarly talent-driven environment**.
* Experience implementing or optimising **reward technology, payroll systems or HRIS integrations**.
* A track record of using **automation, data and technology** to improve the employee and People team experience while strengthening controls.
* Professional qualification or relevant accreditation in **Reward, Compensation & Benefits, HR, Payroll or a related discipline** is desirable but not essential.

#### **Our ideal person**

You’re a **strategic reward leader who is not afraid of the detail**. You can move comfortably from presenting a global compensation recommendation to the CPO, to challenging a payroll variance or negotiating with a benefits provider.

You bring **curiosity, commercial judgement and a continuous-improvement mindset**, and you’re motivated by building reward programmes that are fair, competitive, sustainable and genuinely support the way our people and business operate.

### COMPANY BENEFITS

Croud operates a **hybrid working model** with a **minimum of 3 days a week** based in our **London** **office** and the remaining days from home if you wish.

Croud offers a clear path to progression for all members of staff. We are committed to offering development opportunities alongside a support system of regular performance reviews. The opportunities are endless!

On completion of the three-month probation period, every employee is eligible for the benefits listed on our careers site which include:

* Sabbatical: Paid sabbatical at 7 years with an option to take it unpaid at 5 years
* 25 days holiday a year
* Discretionary annual performance based incentive
* Sale commission
* Recruitment referrals bonus
* Health & Wellbeing contribution

* Ride to Work scheme
* Railcard
* Season Ticket loan
* Home office screen

* Weekly treat: Enjoy a complimentary lunch on us every week
* Enhanced Primary and Secondary family leave as well as extended Parental Leave and Shared Family Leave
* Life insurance and income protection
* Medical Cash Plan
* Pension

Standard hours are from 9.00am to 5.30pm, there’s flexibility if agreed in advance with your line managers (it may also be necessary on occasions to work outside of these hours).

All candidates will be assessed based on merit, qualifications and their ability to perform the requirements of the role.

**Please note: Internal candidates may be considered for this position as part of the selection process, in line with our commitment to transparent and fair recruitment.**

### OUR VALUES

---

At Croud, our vision centres around the idea of unlocking potential. We do this by elevating everyone in an inclusive and progressive culture, empowering individuals to deliver their best work. This means we build better brand outcomes, and unlock potential for our people, our clients and our communities.

**Production Planner - CROWN Packaging Manufacturing UK Limited**

We currently have a vacancy for a Production Planner. The position is based at our Botcherby Plant in Carlisle and is a full-time role working Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week.

The Botcherby Plant is a major supplier of aluminium beverage cans, producing approximately 1.4 billion cans and over 6 billion ring-pull ends annually. The site operates 24/7 and plays a key role within our global operations.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced and knowledgeable individual to join a multinational organisation.

## Job Summary

The Production Planner plays a critical role in ensuring the efficient operation of manufacturing processes by developing and maintaining effective production plans that balance customer demand, production capacity, and material availability. The role is responsible for optimising production schedules to ensure products are manufactured and delivered on time while minimising waste and maximising operational efficiency.

Working closely with cross-functional teams across EMEA, the Production Planner ensures production activities align with business objectives and proactively manages any disruptions that could impact supply continuity.

## 

## Key Responsibilities

The Production Planner is responsible for creating and maintaining detailed production schedules that support business requirements and meet customer expectations. Working collaboratively with Sales, Production, Procurement, Exports, Supply Chain Planning, and other key stakeholders across the region, the role ensures that production plans are aligned with demand forecasts, inventory levels, and operational capabilities.

The role is responsible for developing and maintaining production plans and schedules that support customer demand and business objectives, whilst ensuring alignment of production activities with forecasted demand through close collaboration with Sales, Production, Procurement, Exports, and Supply Chain teams. The Production Planner monitors raw material and finished goods inventory levels, identifying potential shortages, excess stock, and supply risks, and utilises effective inventory, stock, and forecast management techniques to optimise working capital and maintain continuity of supply.

The position coordinates production adjustments and material procurement activities in response to changing business requirements and is responsible for identifying and resolving scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, and production bottlenecks to support efficient manufacturing operations. The Production Planner manages production orders, material requirements, and inventory transactions within ERP/MRP systems, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of planning data at all times.

A key aspect of the role involves reviewing production performance, analysing key performance indicators (KPIs), and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. Corrective actions are implemented where required to improve planning accuracy, service levels, inventory performance, and operational efficiency. The Production Planner also supports engineering change management activities, ensuring that product and process changes are effectively incorporated into production plans with minimal disruption, whilst supporting wider supply continuity initiatives across the EMEA region.

The role is responsible for preparing and delivering regular performance reports to management, highlighting achievements, risks, challenges, and proposed solutions. Compliance with month-end processes, inventory control procedures, company policies, quality standards, and health and safety requirements must be maintained at all times. In addition, the Production Planner is expected to continuously seek opportunities to improve planning processes, systems, reporting tools, and ways of working, while providing flexible support to other site functions during peak periods, holiday cover, business-critical activities, and periods of increased operational demand in order to meet business objectives.

## 

## Qualifications and Experience

The successful candidate will typically possess a qualification in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline, together with a minimum of three to five years' experience in production planning, scheduling, or supply chain roles within a manufacturing environment.

They will have strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, capacity planning, production scheduling, and inventory management principles, together with experience working with ERP/MRP systems such as SAP, Oracle, JD Edwards (JDE), or similar platforms. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are essential, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make informed decisions.

The role requires excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the organisation. Candidates must possess strong organisational and time-management skills and be capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, is also required.

The successful individual will be able to work independently whilst collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams and will be expected to support other site functions during peak periods, holiday cover, business-critical activities, and periods of increased operational demand, providing flexible cross-functional support as required to meet business objectives.

## 

## Key Competencies

The successful Production Planner will demonstrate strong capability in production planning and scheduling, demand and forecast management, inventory optimisation, capacity planning, and supply chain coordination. They will possess a high level of competence in ERP/MRP systems management, data analysis and reporting, continuous improvement methodologies, problem solving, and decision making.

Success in the role will also require excellent stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills, together with the ability to build effective working relationships across functions and regions to support business objectives and operational performance.

**In return you will receive:-**

* performance related pay scheme (over and above basic salary).
* an attractive contributory pension scheme.
* private medical scheme, health cash plan and subsidised dental care.
* life assurance scheme.
* on site canteen.
* cycle to work scheme.
* leave during Christmas/New Year period.
* 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

# Full Stack Engineer - Cloud & SaaS Integrations

Remote UK

**Location**   
Our Full Stack Software Engineer will be an integral part of our R&D team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

**Who We Are**   
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

**The Opportunity**

Cloud spend is no longer just AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Our customers now run a large and growing share of their technology spend through SaaS platforms, data clouds and AI vendors - and every one of those vendors is an integration that brings another slice of their spend into view.

You'll own DoiT's Integrations Framework and the experience built on top of it. This is a chance to define what a great integration experience looks like: a customer connects a new vendor in minutes, sees at a glance that their data is flowing, and handles credential rotation, reconnects and backfills themselves without thinking twice. On the framework side, you'll make adding the next vendor a small, well-understood piece of work rather than a project - so coverage grows as fast as the vendor landscape does.

You'll work AI-augmented from day one. Integration development is spec-driven work against constantly changing third-party APIs: one of the highest-leverage places to apply agentic AI tooling. We expect you to use it across your whole workflow and to have real opinions about where it earns its place.

## Responsibilities

* **Building new integrations.** This is the core of the role. Design and ship integrations against third-party billing and usage APIs - authentication, incremental sync, rate limits, error handling, schema drift - and invest in the Integrations Framework itself, along with testing harnesses and scaffolding, so the tenth integration takes a fraction of the effort of the first.
* **Working AI-augmented.** Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring unfamiliar codebases and third-party APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests, and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar.
* **Integration management experience.** Build the interfaces customers use to connect, configure and trust their integrations: health and status visibility, actionable error states, credential and key rotation, and clear feedback when something needs attention.
* **Self-service by default.** Design self-service into the framework from the start - backfills, reconnects and diagnostics that customers and internal teams run themselves.
* **API-first.** Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform.
* **Implementing features end-to-end.** From proposal, through spec and implementation, to maintenance. You're expected to propose things you think would be a good addition, not wait for a spec.

## Qualifications

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, shipping and owning features in production
* Strong **TypeScript**, including modern frontend work - **React** preferred
* Hands-on experience with **Go**, or strong backend experience in another language (Python, Java, Node.js, C#) with genuine enthusiasm for ramping up in Go quickly
* Real experience designing and consuming **REST APIs**, and integrating third-party APIs with all the mess that entails: auth flows, pagination, rate limits, partial failures, breaking changes
* Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the database through to the interface
* Working proficiency in **SQL**
* Experience developing solutions in the cloud and/or using cloud services (GCP, AWS or Azure)
* A user-facing instinct for operational tooling - you care whether the error message actually tells someone what to do next
* **AI-augmented working style** - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them
* Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles
* Demonstrated passion for creating high-quality web/SaaS apps
* Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal
* Self-organized, goal-oriented and self-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious

## Bonus Points

* Experience building **integration platforms or extensibility frameworks** as a core part of a product
* Experience with **cloud or SaaS billing data** - AWS/GCP/Azure cost and usage exports, AI vendor billing data, marketplace billing, or the FOCUS specification
* Experience with Google BigQuery, or with data pipelines and orchestration tooling (Dagster, Airflow)
* Experience building AI-powered product features (LLM integration, intelligent automation)
* Exposure to FinOps practices or cloud financial management products
* BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

job_title: Lead Product Manager (England or Latvia based)
job_description:
At other companies this role is often called a Group Product Manager or a Product Lead.
Edurio is on its way to improving education quality globally and we’re looking for great people to join us on the journey.
We help schools and school groups survey their parents, pupils, and staff to build organisations where people thrive. We currently work with over 2000 schools in the United Kingdom and Latvia and are planning to grow significantly in the next year.
As a Lead Product Manager, you will shape what gets built on our survey software and in what order. You will lead the product team as we go from one product to more.
The product team and how we work:
You would join a product team of four, including you: two Product Managers and a Data Quality and Analytics Engineer. Development is a separate team of seven.
Our Product Managers each take whichever problems matter most at that time. Somebody works on results and reporting for some time, then on survey filling, so the team understands the whole product rather than defending a corner of it.
The product team is responsible for the whole product: the software, the survey content, the benchmarked question sets, and what the results mean. You will build prototypes, design screens, and write copy.
You would be working with Claude, Notion, Linear, the Material Design framework, and other tools of your choice.
This role is being created because we are expanding, and the Director of Product is becoming responsible for product, service, and support. We are building Edurio HUB as a second product and becoming a multi-product company. You would start in the survey product team, and should expect the scope to grow as that happens.
You report to the Director of Product and Service. The Director owns the product strategy, how much development capacity the product team gets, and the combination of product and service we offer clients.
Your responsibilities:
Lead two Product Managers and our Data Quality and Analytics Engineer
Decide which problems the survey software takes on and in what order, and what we will not do
Make sure what we ship actually gets used
Work with our Data Quality and Analytics Engineer so that clients can rely on the numbers we report, in the platform and in reports
Set the design and copywriting standards both our products are built to
Set how the product team works, and make AI and agents the normal way product and data work gets done
Keep doing product work yourself. This role does not mean you stop making things
What we’re looking for:
Experience owning a software product end to end, including deciding what not to build
Experience managing or coaching product managers, or a clear reason why you are ready to start
Excellent verbal and written English skills
You already use AI and coding agents in your own work, and can tell us what that changed about how you work
Comfort making a call before the evidence is complete, and explaining the reasoning afterwards
Useful, but we do not expect all of these:
Experience or interest in the education sector, preferably in the UK or another English-speaking country
Experience with survey design or research methods
Enough comfort with data models and transformations to review our data engineer's work. We will agree with you how much of this the role needs
This is probably not for you if:
you want to own one area of the product and go deep on it
you want a settled product and a scope that will not change
you would rather set direction than build
The attitudes we'd like to see:
Ownership: You do what you said you would do, and take responsibility for how it lands with the client - not just for completing the task
Genuine care: You build real relationships with clients and colleagues, assume good intentions, and do the right thing rather than the easy thing
Openness: You communicate honestly, don't shy away from difficult conversations, and give and receive feedback well
Growth: You're curious about how things could work better, and you act on what you learn rather than defaulting to how it's always been done
What we offer:
Experience in growing in an international company and a chance to have an impact on education quality
Feedback-based work culture which highly values transparency and team well-being
Flexible working hours, and hybrid working with a preference for at least half the week in our cosy office in central Riga. If you are based in England, the role is fully remote.
Gross salary range: depending on experience €3,500-5,500 per month if based in Latvia or £45,000-65,000 per annum if based in England, as well as company share options, paid phone plan, and health insurance.

# Major Incident Manager

**About Ekco**

🚀 Founded in 2016, Ekco has quickly become one of Europe’s fastest-growing cloud solution providers and your trusted security-first Managed Service Provider.   
IT leaders choose Ekco to drive operational efficiency, scale smarter and stay ahead of risk – powered by local expertise, delivered at European scale.

🌍 Today, we’re a thriving team of 1,000+ talented and supportive colleagues across the UK, Ireland, Benelux, South Africa, and Malaysia—and we’re continuing to grow.

At Ekco, how we work matters as much as what we deliver. Our people live by four core values that shape everything we do:

* **On It**: We take ownership, follow through, and get things done.

* **All** In : We collaborate, support each other, and commit fully to shared goals.

* **Connected**: We build trusted relationships with colleagues, clients, and partners.

* **Hungry to Grow**: We stay curious, keep learning, and push ourselves to the next level.

🏠If these values resonate with you, you’ll feel right at home here.

**The Role**

• Own the major incident management process end to end detection, declaration, coordination, resolution, and closure.

• Make timely, informed decisions on incident severity, escalation paths, and resourcing, including invoking disaster recovery or business continuity plans where required.

• Maintain a single, accurate incident timeline and decision log for every major incident.

• Chair major incident bridge calls, ensuring the right technical resources are engaged, distractions are minimised, and progress is driven with urgency.

**Stakeholder & Customer Communication**

• Provide clear, jargon-free, confidence-inspiring updates to customers and internal stakeholders at agreed intervals throughout an incident.

• Manage communications with senior/executive stakeholders (both customer side and internal) during high-severity or reputationally sensitive incidents.

• Coordinate with Account/Service Delivery Managers to ensure customer specific contractual obligations (SLAs, notification windows, reporting requirements) are met.

• Own the drafting and distribution of incident communications, bridge invites, and status updates.

**Post-Incident & Continual Improvement**

• Lead post-incident reviews (PIRs) for all major incidents, ensuring root cause, contributing factors, and timeline are accurately captured.

• Track root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions through to completion, holding action owners to account.

• Produce major incident reports for customers and internal governance forums, identifying trends and systemic risks.

• Feed lessons learned into problem management, service improvement plans, and process/documentation updates.

**Process, Governance & Reporting**

• Own and continually improve the major incident management process and supporting documentation, aligned to ITIL best practice.

• Maintain and test major incident and communication plans, including periodic simulation/rehearsal exercises.

• Produce regular MI performance reporting (volumes, MTTR, SLA impact, recurring themes) for leadership and customer governance meetings.

• Ensure accurate incident records are maintained in the ITSM toolset (e.g. ServiceNow, Halo, Autotask) for audit, billing, and reporting purposes.

• Support internal and external audits (e.g. ISO 20000, ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials) with evidence of incident management practice.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

• Act as a point of escalation and mentor for the wider service desk and technical teams during incidents, promoting a culture of ownership and urgency.

• Build strong working relationships across Service Desk, Technical Operations, Security, Problem Management, and Account Management functions.

• Represent Major Incident Management in customer-facing governance meetings (Service Reviews, CAB) as required.

• Participate in, and potentially manage, an out-of-hours on-call rota for major incident coverage outside business hours.

**Essential Experience:**  
  
• Proven experience managing major/critical incidents within an MSP, IT service provider, or complex multi-client technical environment.

• Strong working knowledge of ITIL incident, problem, and change management practices (ITIL Foundation certified as a minimum).

• Excellent stakeholder management skills, with demonstrable experience communicating confidently and clearly to senior/executive audiences under pressure.

• Ability to remain calm, decisive, and structured in high-pressure, ambiguous, and time-critical situations.

• Strong technical literacy across common infrastructure, network, cloud, and application technologies, sufficient to challenge technical teams and understand impact/root cause.

• Experience using ITSM tooling (Halo) for incident and reporting purposes.

• Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear customer-facing incident reports under time pressure.

• Experience running or contributing to post-incident reviews and driving corrective actions to completion.

**Desirable**

• ITIL Practitioner/Intermediate qualification (e.g. ITIL 4 Managing Professional).

**Benefits / Perks**

• 🎂 Birthday Leave: One extra day off to celebrate   
• 💰 Company Pension Scheme   
• 📞 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for wellbeing support   
• 🏃‍♀️ EkcOlympics: Global team activity challenges   
• 📚 Unlimited access to Pluralsight for continuous development   
• 🌱 Real opportunities to grow, including international progression

**Why Ekco**

* 🏅 Company of the year 2026 Tech Excellence Awards
* ⭐️ Microsoft’s 2023 Rising Star Security Partner of the Year
* 🚀 First Irish Microsoft MSP to achieve all four Microsoft Security Specializations
* 🌈 A culture rooted in diversity, equality, inclusion & belonging
* 🎉 A commitment to internal mobility and career progression
* ✨ Flexible, family-friendly working at the heart of our culture

# Senior Information Security Infrastructure Engineer - Security Architecture - InfoSec

Distributed Locations:

United Kingdom

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale - unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data - securing and protecting private information more effectively - Elastic's complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

### What is The Role:

Join the **InfoSec - Security Architecture** team as a **Senior Information Security Infrastructure Engineer**, where you'll have the chance to play a key role in protecting our organization's data and systems. This position offers the opportunity to work on meaningful projects that directly impact our security posture and collaborate with a skilled team passionate about information security.

In more details: We ingest the security telemetry that the whole security org runs on. In this role you'll get that telemetry into Elasticsearch consistently and keep the underlying Elastic clusters healthy. You own the pipeline end to end: from a new security data source landing, through ingest pipelines, into the indices detection, IR, and consulting teams query, plus the clusters that store it all.

### What You Will Be Doing:

* Security telemetry ingestion - build and maintain ingestion of security-relevant data into Elasticsearch (cloud provider audit logs, identity/SaaS activity, endpoint and asset data). This means integrating with third-party and cloud provider APIs to pull telemetry: auth, pagination, rate limits, and handling schema changes. Both Elastic integrations and one-off custom integrations.
* Keep the Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes clusters healthy. Monitor and upgrade them regularly. This involves updating versions and builds. Manage capacity and shards. Handle index lifecycle management (ILM). Enable cross-cluster search (CCS).
* Use Terraform to manage cloud infrastructure and Elasticsearch resources. This includes managing pipelines, index templates, and alerts. Utilize Kubernetes and Helm to deploy scheduled ingest jobs.
* Use AI automation and tooling to reduce toil. This includes self-healing jobs and health checks. It also involves alerting, internal CLIs, and AI or agent-assisted workflows for investigation and operations.

### What You Bring:

* Ability to operate Elastic and Elasticsearch in production. This includes managing ingest pipelines, index templates, mappings, and queries, while ensuring that clusters are healthy and upgraded. Experience with ECK or Elasticsearch on Kubernetes is strongly preferred.
* Proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and accelerate operations, while still owning the final outcomes.
* Kubernetes - deploying and operating workloads (scheduled jobs, Helm charts, operators); troubleshooting pods/jobs in a cluster.
* Terraform - managing cloud and Elasticsearch resources as code.
* API integration - consuming REST APIs for data ingestion: authentication, pagination, rate limiting concurrency, and error handling.
* Python scripting - able to read, write, and modify ingestion/automation scripts. Scripting-level, not full software-engineering depth.
* Eligibility to work in Department of Defense (DoD) Impact Level 4 or above cloud service environments.

### Bonus Points:

* Experience with cloud providers.
* Hands-on experience with cloud providers, preferably GCP, and working with audit and logging data.
* Knowledge of GitHub, PR-based workflows, GitHub Actions and Continuous Integration (CI).
* Knowledge of SOC operations and incident response (IR) workflows, including the use of security telemetry during investigations.
* Ability to develop and use dashboard/visualization tools.

### Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you're looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn't matter if you're just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

* **being responsible**for a clinical caseload
* **carrying out** assessments
* **maintaining** accurate records for people receiving occupational therapies
* **promoting** choice, dignity and independence.

* creative thinking and sound **organisational** skills

FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

**FactSet Overview**

FactSet is a leader in providing research, data, and analytical tools to finance professionals. Our clients combine hundreds of databases from industry-leading suppliers into a single, powerful information system—delivering instant access to accurate financial data and analytics around the world.

**Deep Sector Initiative**

Deep Sector is FactSet’s strategic effort to collect new content, enhance existing fundamentals coverage, and deliver advanced reports, analytics, and workflow functionality across nine industry verticals: Banks, Insurance, Real Estate, Power & Utilities, TMT, Metals & Mining, Oil & Gas, Specialty Finance, and Healthcare.

Deep Sector data extends beyond traditional public-company financial statements, providing granular, industry-specific intelligence on public and private companies, assets, transactions, regulatory disclosures, news, and other specialized content.

**Position Overview**

Join the Deep Sector Financial Institutions Group as a Global FIG Industry Lead for FactSet’s Banking and Insurance offerings across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific and global leadership responsibilities for FIG AI and MCP initiatives.

This senior role has two complementary mandates. First, you will lead international client engagement, market development, and product opportunity identification for FactSet’s Banking and Insurance offerings. Second, you will lead Deep Sector FIG’s contribution to FactSet’s broader AI and MCP initiatives globally. Partner with FactSet’s AI, Applications, Content, and Engineering teams to ensure Banking and Insurance content is structured, contextualized, discoverable, and reliable for AI-enabled and agentic workflows. Engage directly with clients to identify high-value use cases, translate emerging workflow needs into content and product requirements, and develop clear positioning, commercialization, and go-to-market plans for new capabilities.

You will work closely with FactSet’s global Banking and Insurance industry leads, established product and content owners, Applications, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Sales, Go-to-Market and third-party data teams. Success in this role will require strong FIG domain expertise, deep client engagement, strategic judgment, and the ability to lead complex initiatives through a matrixed organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Regional Client and Market Leadership:** Serve as a senior Banking and Insurance industry representative for FactSet across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. Independently lead senior client meetings, product discovery sessions, roadmap and partnership discussion across these markets.  Build relationships with clients, prospects, industry participants, and strategic partners to understand regional workflows, unmet needs, and emerging market requirements.
* **Product Strategy and Roadmap:** Contribute to the global FIG product strategy and roadmap by identifying and evaluating Banking and Insurance opportunities across international markets. Bring regional client needs, regulatory developments, competitive intelligence, usage data, and commercial opportunities into the global prioritization process, and lead the execution of agreed initiatives.
* **Go-to-Market Strategy:** Partner with Go-to Market Leads to help develop regional go-to-market strategies for FactSet’s FIG products and capabilities. Partner with Sales, Consulting, Growth, and Marketing to define target client segments, priority workflows, product positioning, launch plans, pilot programs, and sales-enablement materials.
* **Commercialization:** Support the commercialization of new and existing Banking and Insurance products through differentiated positioning, packaging, pricing recommendations, client demonstrations, and targeted adoption campaigns. Identify opportunities to drive new business, cross-sell existing clients, improve retention, and expand the use of FactSet’s FIG content across applications, data feeds, and APIs.
* **AI and MCP Product Leadership:** Lead Deep Sector FIG’s contribution to FactSet’s AI and Model Context Protocol-enabled products and workflows. Engage directly with Banking and Insurance clients to understand how generative AI, agentic research, and automated analytical workflows are evolving and identify high-value use cases. Translate these emerging client needs into requirements for making FIG content, metadata, and analytics AI-ready, contextualized, discoverable, and accessible through MCP and related technologies. Partner with the AI Foundry, Applications, Content, and Engineering teams to develop, test, and commercialize new capabilities.
* **Special Projects and Initiative Execution:** Lead high-priority FIG initiatives that span regions, products, or organizational teams. Establish clear objectives, requirements, roles, milestones, dependencies, and success measures, and drive approved initiatives from concept through client validation, delivery, launch, and post-launch evaluation.
* **Requirements and Business-Case Development:** Translate client conversations, market research, usage analysis, and regulatory developments into clear opportunity assessments, business cases, product requirements, functional specifications, data requirements, and user stories. Ensure recommendations account for client value, strategic fit, revenue potential, implementation complexity, and ongoing operating costs.
* **Data and Content Opportunity Identification:** Identify regulatory filings, proprietary datasets, and third-party data partners that could enhance FactSet’s international Banking and Insurance offerings. Evaluate potential sources based on coverage, quality, timeliness, licensing rights, strategic differentiation, implementation requirements, and commercial economics.
* **Data Partnerships:** Develop recommendations for licensing, partnership, build, and acquisition opportunities. For approved opportunities, work with established product, content, and third-party data owners to define requirements and support implementation while preserving clear ownership of ongoing data operations.
* **International Regulatory and Reporting Coverage:** Monitor changes in international Banking and Insurance accounting, regulatory, and disclosure requirements. Identify opportunities associated with frameworks such as IFRS 9, IFRS 17, Basel and Pillar 3 disclosures, Solvency II, and relevant local regulatory reporting regimes.
* **Cross-Functional Governance and Delivery:** Partner with global Banking and Insurance industry leads and established product and content owners to integrate regional priorities into FactSet’s global roadmap. Work through established product-governance and prioritization processes so that international initiatives complement, rather than duplicate, existing product ownership.
* **Competitive Intelligence:** Maintain a clear view of the international FIG data and analytics landscape, including competitor products, regional data providers, regulatory sources, emerging technologies, and changing client expectations. Use this intelligence to inform strategy, positioning, partnerships, and investment decisions.
* **Presentation and Sales Enablement:** Work with the Sales Enablement team to help develop and deliver compelling product demonstrations, strategic presentations, workflow examples, and training materials for clients, prospects, Sales, Consulting, senior leadership, and other internal stakeholders.
* **Performance Measurement and Continuous Improvement:** Establish success measures for regional and AI-enabled initiatives, including product adoption, client engagement, usage, revenue contribution, implementation progress, and client satisfaction. Use these measures to refine priorities, improve products, and inform future investment.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Relevant Experience:** At least 10 years of experience in Banking, Insurance, FIG research, financial data, financial technology, product strategy, or a related field.
* **FIG Domain Expertise:** Deep expertise in Banking or Insurance and a strong working understanding of the other industry. Relevant backgrounds may include:
  + Buy-side or sell-side research covering banks, insurers, or other financial institutions.
  + Banking or Insurance strategy, finance, accounting, regulatory reporting, data management, or product development.

Reporting to the Purchasing Manager, the Purchasing Lead will take ownership of a portfolio of key suppliers, managing supplier relationships and supporting the delivery of our operational and commercial objectives.

This is a key role within our purchasing function, working closely with Project Management, Engineering, Quality, Business Development and other stakeholders to ensure supplier performance meets the needs of the business.

You will be responsible for managing key supplier accounts, supporting supplier development and identifying opportunities to improve performance, value and supply chain resilience. You will also play an important role in developing our long-term procurement strategy and supporting future business growth.

We are looking for a confident and commercially minded negotiator who can build strong, long-term supplier relationships while constructively challenging suppliers to deliver better value and performance.

* Own and manage relationships with key suppliers, acting as the primary point of contact for commercial and operational matters.
* Act as a lead purchasing contact for Project Managers on dedicated projects, providing input into project plans, reporting on material status and issuing works orders where required.

You will have proven experience in a purchasing or procurement role, ideally gained within a **manufacturing, engineering or electronics environment**.
