‍  
We are now building out an in-house development function, and this is the first hire into it.

‍

## Role Overview

Almost everything we run internally has been built in-house: reconciliation tooling, bank API integrations, document verification, operational reporting, and our client-facing platform. Software is not a support function here. It is how the business moves faster than firms ten times its size.

‍  
We are looking for a Junior Developer to work directly alongside our Lead Developer on that toolset.

‍  
This is not a role where you will be handed a ticket and a specification. You will be handed a problem, usually described by someone in operations or trading who does not know what the solution looks like, and you will be expected to work out what actually needs building.

‍  
We build with AI tooling as standard. We are not looking for someone who can write a linked list on a whiteboard. We are looking for someone who can take an ambiguous business problem, break it down, build something that works, and know the difference between code that runs and code that is correct.

‍

‍

## Your Mission

#### Business Development & Portfolio Growth

* Build and maintain internal tools that automate manual operational processes
* Work directly with operations, trading, and compliance to scope problems before building anything
* Integrate with third-party systems: bank APIs, Salesforce, internal databases
* Investigate and fix defects in existing systems, including code you did not write
* Test your own work properly, including the failure cases, before it goes anywhere near live data
* Document what you build so someone else can pick it up
* Flag risk early and loudly, particularly anything touching client money

‍

## What You’ll Need

#### Experience & Background

* 0-3 years previous experience in developing
* Demonstrable ability to build and ship working software, however you acquired it. Degree, bootcamp, self-taught, or a folder of things you built for yourself, we genuinely do not mind
* A working understanding of at least one language (we mostly use Python and JavaScript) and the confidence to pick up others as required
* Comfort with the fundamentals: APIs, databases, version control, how data moves between systems
* Fluent, critical use of AI coding tools. You should be able to tell us where they have been wrong and how you caught it
* Evidence that you have built something nobody asked you to build
* Clear written communication, including the ability to explain a technical decision to someone non-technical

‍

**Nice to Have**

* Salesforce experience (Apex, SOQL, Flows)
* Exposure to financial services, payments, or another regulated environment
* Experience integrating with third-party or banking APIs
* SQL beyond the basics
* Any exposure to Excel automation or replacing spreadsheet-based processes
* A GitHub, a portfolio, a side project, or anything else we can look at

None of the above are dealbreakers. All of them are things we would be pleased to see.

‍

**Mindset & Culture Fit**

* High agency. You see a problem, you go and understand it, and you come back with something
* Comfortable being wrong quickly rather than right slowly
* You stop and ask whether a problem is even solvable before spending three days on it
* Careful where it matters. You understand that in this business a silent failure is worse than a loud one
* Highly coachable with a strong desire to improve
* Comfortable operating in a high-standards, feedback-driven environment

You are not expected to be fully formed. You are expected to be commercially serious, coachable, and accountable.

‍

## You’re the right fit for us if

* You're curious and ask why
* You would rather challenge a bad requirement than build to it
* You want to find the right solution, not the first one
* You want to improve and seek feedback
* You like to be challenged
* You aspire to make an impact and be part of a team

‍

## What Success Looks Like

#### Within your first 6-12 months, you will:

* Independently own and deliver small to mid-sized internal tools end to end
* Be trusted to scope a request directly with the stakeholders without supervision
* Have measurably removed manual work from at least one operational process
* Ship changes that reach production without introducing defects into live processes
* Be a second pair of eyes on the Lead Developer's work, not just a recipient of it

‍

## Remuneration & Progression:

* Competitive base salary
* Structured coaching and development plan from the Lead Developer
* Genuine ownership of projects from an early stage
* Clear progression as the development function grows around you

‍

## Why Join Millbank FX

Millbank FX is built for ambitious individuals who want genuine opportunity, ownership, and growth.

‍  
When you join Millbank FX, you become part of a fast-growing, high-performance business where your contribution directly impacts growth. You won't be another number inside a large corporate structure or constrained by bureaucracy and outdated systems.

‍  
As the first hire into our development function, you will have visibility of the entire business and a direct line to the people whose problems you are solving. What you build gets used the same week, by people sitting in the same room.

# Head of Engineering, POS Application Platform

**Who we are**

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

**Why United Kingdom**

The UK is home to our headquarters where more than 70 team members are based. Our London office is located at Sea Containers, just by London Bridge - this is also where a significant number of our most senior leaders sit, which makes it a natural base for a Head of Engineering.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, POS Apps to join us in the UK.

**About the role**  
  
  
More than 6 million businesses run their financial lives through Moniepoint - and the primary way they interact with us every single day is through a POS device. For most of our merchants, that device is their business. It is how they accept payments, how they access credit, and how they track their finances. Everything those devices are capable of, in terms of speed, reliability, and developer quality, flows from the engineering platform this role leads.

We are building a dedicated POS Application Platform function: the foundational Kotlin-based engineering layer that sits beneath every POS product at Moniepoint. Think of it as the operating system for our POS engineering organisation - the standards, frameworks, tooling, and architectural backbone that every POS engineer across the business builds on top of. This is not a feature team. It is a platform team in the truest sense, and the Head of Engineering for POS Application Platform is the technical owner of that layer.

We currently operate across five POS device types from multiple OEM manufacturers, all running on Android. The engineering challenges here span device governance, developer experience, platform reliability, foundational frameworks, and adoption across a distributed set of POS engineers working in separate product squads.

And the scope is growing. We have a UK entity live, a cross-border payments product in market, and a microfinance bank acquisition which just finalized in Kenya. The platform you build will become the foundation for tens of millions of businesses across multiple markets to accept payments, access financial services, and grow. If you have spent your career going deep on POS systems and you want to build the platform that underpins one of Africa's most consequential fintech businesses during its expansion, this is the role.

**What you'll get to do**

* Own the technical strategy and architecture for the POS Application Platform, acting as the domain CTO for everything that runs on our POS devices.
* Build and govern the four core platform pillars across the organisation: developer experience (tools, libraries, SDKs), platform reliability (observability, uptime, quality standards), foundational frameworks (architecture, coding standards, testing and release pipelines), and squad adoption (driving uptake of platform tooling across all embedded POS engineers).
* Define and enforce engineering standards across all POS device types and OEM manufacturers, ensuring architectural consistency and quality across a heterogeneous device fleet.
* Functionally lead POS engineers embedded across Payments, Onboarding, VAS, Savings, and Loans squads - setting the bar for engineering quality and providing the platform layer above all of them.
* Own POS observability end-to-end: monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks that ensure platform health across all devices and squads.
* Drive the architecture for how Moniepoint supports multiple POS device types, including defining how new devices are onboarded, governed, and integrated with the platform.
* Collaborate with OEM partners and the POS hardware team when new device types are introduced, ensuring the application layer is ready to support them from day one.
* Build and scale the POS platform team, including hiring, mentoring, and structuring for growth as the platform expands internationally.
* Translate platform decisions into business impact, working closely with Product, Payments, and Business leadership across markets.
* Establish and continuously improve engineering processes, tooling standards, CI/CD pipelines, and developer productivity metrics across the POS engineering community.

**To succeed in this role, we think you should have**

* A minimum of 10 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with at least 6 years leading engineering teams through meaningful growth phases, ideally in multi-national or large VC-backed companies.
* Direct, hands-on experience building software that runs on Point-of-Sale terminal devices. This means engineering on the device itself — the application layer — not server-side integrations with POS systems. This is a non-negotiable requirement and candidates without it will not be considered.
* Strong working knowledge of EMV standards (Europay, Mastercard, Visa) and experience navigating payment certification processes such as PCI DSS and P2PE. Candidates without this will not be considered.
* Deep Android engineering expertise in Kotlin and Java. The POS application layer at Moniepoint is Android-based and there are no exceptions to this requirement.
* Proven experience building internal engineering platforms, shared libraries, developer tooling, or foundational frameworks used by other engineering teams — not just consumer-facing feature products.
* Experience governing or architecting across multiple POS device types from different hardware manufacturers, with an understanding of how OEM integrations and device management work at scale.
* Experience building or maturing platform engineering functions, including establishing engineering processes, tooling strategies, and cross-squad governance structures.
* Demonstrated ability to scale engineering teams and build the organisational layer beneath you — leaders who can grow into and around the role you are hiring into.
* Experience at a company processing high volumes of financial transactions in a regulated environment. Fintech background is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with terminal management systems and device observability tooling is a strong advantage.
* Backend engineering experience in Java or Spring Boot is a strong plus given the breadth of the platform and the integration surface it sits on.
* Experience working directly with OEM vendors on hardware specification and integration is a bonus.
* Exposure to C or C++ is a plus — one of our device variants uses C.
* Experience at Series A or B stage startups alone is unlikely to reflect the scale and complexity required for this role.

**Cultural Alignment**

We assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

* Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
* Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
* Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
* Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
* Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
* No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
* Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
* Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

**Some of the technologies you'll work with**

* Android (Kotlin, Java) - primary platform for all POS application development
* EMV payment standards and PCI/P2PE certification frameworks
* Multiple POS device types and OEM manufacturers, including Topwise and Telpo
* Terminal management systems and device observability tooling
* Java, Spring Boot — backend services and integration layer
* Docker and Kubernetes
* PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch
* Microservices architecture on AWS

**What we can offer you**

* Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
* Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
* Compensation - You will receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

**What to expect in the hiring process**

* Stage 1: A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
* Stage 2: Technical Round focused on core technical strengths and depth in Android/Kotlin
* Stage 3: System Design - You will be asked to solve complex system design problems to assess your technical and architectural skills, with a particular focus on POS and mobile platform architecture and payment systems.
* Stage 4: Technical and Architectural Leadership - An interview with one Head of Engineering focused on leadership skills and attributes.
* Stage 5: CTO Interview - A conversation with our CTO assessing first-principles thinking, problem-solving under ambiguity, clarity of thought, and cultural alignment.

How to apply: Please send us your CV or LinkedIn profile via our career website.

# Platform Engineer

Monumo is an AI company focused on optimising complex engineering systems. Starting with electric motors, our Anser® AI Engine combines deep domain knowledge with multi-physics simulation, machine learning, and large-scale compute. We evaluate millions of candidate designs a day to find optimal trade-offs across performance, cost, weight, and efficiency.  
Electric motors are a proving ground for complex, system-level engineering challenges: they consume over half the world's electricity, and small design gains compound at system level. We're a well-funded deeptech startup based in Cambridge and Coventry, with a core team from Arm, Microsoft Research, DeepMind, and academia.

## Why we need you

Behind Monumo's designs are simulation, optimisation, and machine learning workloads running on our own compute cluster and in the cloud. We're now putting that capability directly into the hands of our customers, and your role will be the platform layer in between: the systems that take a job from submission, through scheduling and execution, to results delivered securely and efficiently. Much of this is new, and you'll have a real say in how it's designed, working alongside engineers and scientists from physics, motor engineering, and AI backgrounds.

### Your responsibilities will include

* Backend services that put computational workloads behind customer-facing APIs
* Batch job lifecycle systems: submission, scheduling, retries, cancellation, priority
* Identity and access across our services: how people, services, and machines authenticate, and what they're allowed to do, from cloud through to cluster
* Customer isolation: protecting commercially sensitive designs while running an efficient shared compute platform
* The data lifecycle around simulation: storing, versioning, and moving large results, and getting them to customers
* The path from code to running system: packaging, containerisation, CI/CD, and deployment workflows that scientists actually enjoy using
* Observability: knowing what the platform is doing, both for our own engineering and for the security standards our customers expect
* Fault-finding across the stack: tracing issues through services, containers, Linux, and the network
* Close collaboration with frontend and product engineering on the interfaces customers and colleagues use (this is a backend role; UI skills are welcome but not the focus).

### What you'll bring

We're open-minded about your technical background. More important than any specific skill is your willingness to learn.

* Strong software engineering in a modern language. Our code is mostly Python today, with Rust growing where performance and reliability matter
* Care for code quality: typing, testing, and review
* Experience designing systems and the APIs between them: services that coordinate work, manage state, and handle failure
* Curiosity about scientific computing. We write much of our own simulation code; you don't need to know finite element methods, but we want someone keen to understand what the jobs compute, and to help them run faster and scale.

### You'll have experience in some of these

* Cloud computing or HPC job management (e.g. Slurm)
* Identity and authorisation flows (e.g. OAuth2/OIDC)
* Deploying containerised services on Linux (e.g. Podman)
* Infrastructure as code (e.g. Ansible, OpenTofu)
* Modern Python tooling and packaging (e.g. uv)
* Data storage and pipelines, including large simulation results and model serving
* APIs, REST, WebSockets (e.g. FastAPI).

### You will thrive in our team

If you're motivated by solving real technical problems through open-minded, interdisciplinary thinking, and by learning new things along the way. We value people who share ideas about how we can do things better, who balance autonomy with collaboration across different backgrounds (physics, engineering, operations), and who enjoy a dynamic environment

We assess, develop and manage cyber threats across our increasingly connected society. We advise global technology, manufacturers, financial institutions, critical national infrastructure providers, retailers and governments on the best way to keep businesses, software and personal data safe.

## The role

NeuroDoctrine is building the neural operating system for defence and space, the platform that lets a single mind command a swarm of machines, in real time. We're a small, fast-moving team turning a decade of peer-reviewed neuroscience into doctrine, and this September we step out of stealth for the first time.

We are seeking a dynamic and highly organized Executive Assistant (EA) to join our team and provide exceptional support to senior leadership. You'll own NeuroDoctrine's admin work across a genuinely multi-jurisdictional footprint, the UK, the US, and Belgium, at exactly the moment the company is scaling from a founding team to a workforce that has to move as fast as the technology does. This role is vital in ensuring smooth daily operations, managing schedules, coordinating communications, and handling administrative tasks with precision and professionalism. The selected candidate will run our HR operations end-to-end (recruitment, contracts, records, visas), support leadership directly with confidential scheduling and correspondence, and coordinate major projects, including the Neurotech for Defence & Space Summit and our new podcast, the 42-Minute Briefing. Three genuinely different disciplines, one person, and real ownership across all three.

## What you’ll do

### Recruitment

* Coordinate candidate interviews and manage applicant communication end-to-end.
* Screen CVs against role requirements and conduct first-stage structured behavioural interviews.
* Coordinate background checks and prepare offer documentation.
* Organise recruitment events and university partnerships.

### HR Administration

* Prepare contracts, letters, personnel documents, and confidential files using company templates.
* Manage employee records through our People Performance & Culture (PPC) portal — new starters, holidays, sick leave, payslips, contact details, and salary changes.
* Coordinate visa sponsorship applications, invitation letters, and right-to-work checks, working with external immigration counsel on anything beyond standard casework.
* Support onboarding and general HR projects.

### Executive & Confidential Support

Manage diaries, meetings, interviews, leadership reviews, and confidential appointments across both entities.

* Book rooms and coordinate schedules across participants and time zones (UK, US, Belgium). Arrange flights, hotels, transport, and itineraries for leadership and international visitors.
* Coordinate international visitors and executive logistics, including government, military, and investor guests.
* Handle confidential correspondence and follow-up actions.

### Project Coordination

* Coordinate major events, including the Neurotech for Defence & Space Summit and annual retreats.
* Manage venues, suppliers, invitations, attendee lists, travel, and logistics.
* Coordinate internal and external stakeholders across the event lifecycle

### Our New Tech Podcast — the 42-Minute Briefing

* Coordinate recording, studio, equipment, and filming logistics.
* Coordinate and communicate with guests, including scheduling and follow-ups.
* Liaise with editing and publishing suppliers, and coordinate releases of social-media assets.
* Track podcast performance metrics and maintain a pipeline of potential guests and topics.
* Support partnerships, sponsorships, and cross-promotion.

## What you’ll bring

You are exceptionally organised, discreet, and proactive. You don't wait to be told what needs doing, you anticipate it. You are comfortable operating with incomplete information, managing competing priorities, and dealing confidently with senior stakeholders. You have excellent judgement, understand confidentiality, and can move seamlessly between arranging an executive's international travel, resolving an HR issue, coordinating a senior government visitor, and getting a major event over the line. You take ownership. If something sits within your remit, you make sure it gets done.

### Skills

* Proven administrative experience
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks efficiently in a busy environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace tools (Docs, Sheets, Calendar)
* Strong typing skills coupled with attention to detail to ensure error-free documentation
* Exceptional phone etiquette and communication skills for professional interactions at all levels
* Demonstrated ability to handle multiple responsibilities simultaneously while maintaining a positive attitude
* Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgement to build structure without slowing anyone down
* A bias to action that matches a team stepping out of stealth in six weeks, not six months

This role will grow in scope and compensation as NeuroDoctrine scales. This is a ground-floor opportunity at a company about to go public, working directly alongside NATO, government, and investor guests.

## Benefits

* Equity participation/employee share option scheme
* UK visa sponsorship

* ## About the Role
* A senior technologist provides strong analytical skills, technical delivery capability and practical engineering judgement, working with the Lead Technologist to implement architectures that are secure, sustainable and aligned to organisational goals. This role balances hands-on build work with design review, technical documentation, operational support and continuous improvement among scientific and business projects alike.

  **Key responsibilities**

  + Deliver high-quality technology changes and IT solutions across one or more scientific services, platforms and scientific project environments, working in multidisciplinary teams
  + Design, build and improve solutions using modern engineering practices (version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure/configuration as code where appropriate)
  + Contribute to code reviews, technical discovery, technical spikes and proof-of-concepts, helping teams make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, cost, risk and quality

* ## About You
* Are you passionate about IT, science, technology and engineering?

  Do you enjoy building and learning about systems, even outside of work (like homelabbing)?

  Got a background in an IT related field (including software)?

  Do you have a curious mind?

  Do you want to build and maintain IT Lego and get paid to do it?

  **This may be the role for you!**

  NPL is looking to build a team to support our scientific projects with their IT system needs.
  On a daily basis, you'll be working as part of a team of similar minded and capable IT professionals
  to apply your existing software, hardware, networking and security skills to design, build and
  maintain IT solutions to meet user needs in a science heavy environment, and blueprint what you
  build so it can be reused for other systems.

  This is a hands-on role suited towards someone with a passion for IT, wherein you will be expected to make
  technical decisions, implement them and own the outcomes, always seeking to improve. We are looking
  for someone who can both deliver and design solutions that can be understood, supported and
  maintained by others in the wider IT team.

  This is not a role for someone who simply implements predefined textbook solutions. You will be
  expected to understand scientific requirements, translate them into robust technical designs with a
  focus on user needs, and make engineering decisions with a high degree of autonomy. You should be
  comfortable operating across both hands-on delivery and solution architecture.

  The solutions you design and build will be provided as **services** by the wider IT
  team to our internal customers, and we expect them to be run with formality, expectation, reliability,
  predictability and maintainability. To do this, you must have a solid grasp of customer
  requirements, technical judgement and excellent communication skills with the customer and the wider IT team.

  ## Skills and Knowledge

  You'll be working with a lot of software and hardware in the role. Knowledge of the tooling is
  desirable but not essential. You must be comfortable learning unfamiliar technologies quickly.
  We'll support this through giving you dedicated time and on-the-job training.

  ### Software and Platforms

  + Linux
  + Docker
  + Python
  + Microsoft Azure
  + GitLab
  + FastAPI
  + Ansible
  + Node-RED
  + Traefik
  + Grafana
  + Loki
  + Prometheus
  + MikroTik RouterOS
  + BookStack
  + Draw.io
  + FreshService ITSM

  ### Hardware

  + Routers
  + Switches
  + Firewalls
  + Micro Form-Factor PCs
  + Single-board computers such as Raspberry Pi
  + Mini clusters of NUCs
  + Large-scale HDD and SSD storage systems

  ## Nature of the Job

  The nature of the job will be to help projects with the underlying IT systems that facilitate
  experiments and research, such as:

  + Getting data from point A to point B, anywhere in the world.
  + Building a sensor acquisition system
    - For air quality monitoring?
    - For temperature monitoring?
    - or factory noise monitoring?
    - ... or for any other use case our scientists may come up with!
  + Enabling remote control of instruments in the field (sometimes actually in a field)
  + Helping build systems to visualise and present data either in post, or during experiments using technologies
    like timeseries databases and Grafana.
  + Sharing said data (and access) with collaborators and partners.
  + Building proof-of-concept systems and demos for viability studies and and project bids.
  + Advising scientists and engineers on data processing pipelines.
  + Building proof-of-concept instrument automation systems.
  + Implementing off-the-shelf containerised applications in an NPL-specific environment with customisations,
    IaC configurations, and resilience.
  + Helping scientists containerise existing applications and provide and support a platform to host them.

  ## Principles

  **Core to the role, is the principle of "you build it, you own it" spread across the team.** We
  adopt a site reliability engineering mindset, approach, and practice to our work. We look to eliminate single
  points of failure and avoid those midnight calls of "the service is down" at all costs. From a
  technical perspective, this means self-healing services, failovers, redundancy, and high availability are core
  to our architecture and operations. From a people perspective, we are all expected to be able to maintain all
  the services we have. Nobody going on annual leave should result in an operational problem.

  **Core to the team, is the principle of individual accountability and shared reward.** If you win,
  everyone wins. It's in our interests to make sure that everyone on the team can support each other, and the
  services we provide. Documentation of processes, solutions, and systems will be the main enabler of other people
  in the team, so your written English, ability to communicate visually with diagrams, and author documents in
  such a way they can be followed and understood by others is instrumental to the role.

  **Core to the team, is the principle of learn once, teach many.** At NPL, curiosity is valued and
  knowledge is shared. When someone discovers a new technology, technique or idea, they're encouraged to bring it
  back to the team through demos, toolbox talks, whiteboard sessions and informal workshops. We actively make time
  for this because we believe the fastest way for everyone to grow is to learn from each other's real-world
  experiences.

  **Core to NPL, are our company values: Give it our all, Nurture and respect, Keep it simple, Get
  connected, and Be bold.** These are at the heart of what we do, and they shape the way we interact,
  develop our people and celebrate success.

  Absolutely vital to the role is to be seen as an expert that your fellow IT colleagues can look up to, seek
  advice from and ultimately emulate as an example of a true IT professional.

  ## Previous Experience with a Good Fit

  People who may be a good fit for this role could come from a wide range of practical, hands-on backgrounds. This
  might include school or college sysadmins who are used to doing a lot with limited resources, SME IT sysadmins
  in similar environments, former start-up IT or software professionals looking for greater stability, or people
  whose formal career has been outside IT but who have built strong technical capability through curiosity and
  hobby projects. Homelabbers, IT security professionals who want to build better systems, people who have moved
  across several IT disciplines, and automation engineers or manufacturing IT specialists may all bring the
  breadth, adaptability and practical judgement needed to succeed in this role. Don't worry if you're not one of
  these, we'll check out your experience and look for similar traits.

  ## Responsibilities

  **Key responsibilities include:**
  + Reviewing incoming requests from internal customers and making
    determination on whether their requests can be solved using existing capabilities, combinations of existing
    capabilities, or something new.
  + Designing, documenting, building, sharing, and operating IT
    solutions and services, at pace, across the full tech stack from infrastructure to frontend and handing over
    long term solutions to operational IT teams.
  + Designing, documenting, building, sharing, and operating processes
    to support IT solutions to reduce personnel single-point-of-failure.
  + Facilitating the transition of services into NPL's IT
    operations team where there is a need for them to exist longer than their agreed lifetime.
  + Writing and maintaining small pieces of production-quality software
    in alignment with enterprise software quality standards.
  + Working across NPL functions to gather user stories, analyse
    feasibility, and operate in an agile team to deliver value sooner and focus on setting up projects for easy
    expansion and evolution.
  + Review code of other team members to ensure effectiveness, quality,
    and maintainability.
  + Writing short whitepapers on technology and solutions to highlight
    key benefits, trade-offs, and facilitate knowledge sharing within NPL.

  ## Success in the Role

  **To be successful in this role:**
  + You will need excellent communication skills. We really need this one and cannot emphasise enough how
    important this is for the success of this role.
  + You must be curious, have a thirst for knowledge, and be willing to throw away previous best practices when
    better practices are discovered.
  + You should have recent, proven experience in designing and building IT systems.
  + You should be degree-level educated in computer science, a related discipline, or have equivalent experience
    (We are super flexible on this as long as you can demonstrate. We care more about evidence of curiosity,
    judgement and delivery than a conventional career path.)
  + You must have reasonable knowledge and experience in a programming language (python preferred, though other
    languages accepted)
  + You must have a strong understanding and demonstrable knowledge of IP networking, TCP/UDP, and layer 5-7
    protocols (HTTP, TLS, REST, FTP, SSH)
  + You must be meticulous with your eye for detail and quality but know when to apply limits to it.
  + Trust and reliability must be core to your work ethic. You are going to be depended upon by many people for
    what you do. If you struggle with structure in your work and life, this role isn't for you.
  + You need to be able to commute to our Teddington site up to 5 days a week as you will need to be hands on with
    hardware, and ideally hold (or be willing to attain) a UK driving license asthere may be an infrequent need
    to travel to our hub sites with equipment. There will be opportunities for work-from-home and flexibility
    with when you do this.
  + You must be willing to join an on-call rota within a year of starting the role.
  + You must be able to pass a BPSS security check, obtain SC clearance, and be a UK national.

  ## Development and Career Progression

  Throughout the role, you'll not only be learning a huge amount, but will have the opportunity to influence
  standards and strategy within IT. This includes shaping the function, participating in CI activities, and
  contributing to strategy. You'll have internal career opportunities to specialise into other areas of IT
  including Infrastructure, Networks, Cyber Security, and Software Engineering roles. You may also be eligible
  for internal promotion based on your delivery. We have an internal career paths initiative that looks at
  career roadmaps and documents the skills needed to get there.

  Mentoring is also an opportunity we provide, both as a mentee and a mentor. Junior members of staff, early
  career, and even those with seniority looking for a career change may be looking for a mentor, and you may
  be able to fulfil that role. Similarly if you're looking for options in techncial leadership, strategic
  leadership, or a career change, we can support getting you a mentor as well.

  ## The Interview Process

  The interview process will be in three stages. Upon being shortlisted, you'll have a screening call first,
  followed by a first stage interview. You'll be given a technical challenge to complete along with preparing
  a presentation on your architecture and design trade-offs, and a quick demo of your solution. You'll then
  have a final stage interview to present this and answer some more technical questions.

  **Usage of AI Tooling Throughout the Process**

  Whilst we don't prohibit the use of generative AI for building your solution, you will be expected to
  demonstrate a deep understanding of what ever you produce. The role will also demand that you can work on
  projects that have strict security and supply chain requirements and may be air-gapped, with no access
  to AI tools. We want to know you can do it without relying on AI tech. Copying and pasting code and
  boilerplate from the internet is acceptable but be prepared for questions that will probe your understanding
  and explaining what and why you have made certain design choices

  **We actively recruit citizens of all backgrounds, but the nature of our work in specific departments means that nationality, residency and security requirements can be more tightly defined. You will be asked about this throughout the recruitment process. To work at NPL, you will need to obtain BPSS security clearance.**

  *Please note:  Applications will be reviewed, and interviews conducted throughout the duration of this advert therefore we may at any time bring the closing date forward.  We encourage all interested applicants to apply as soon as practical.*

job_title: Graduate AI and Software Engineer - Automotive MPUs
job_description:
## The mission:

The car is becoming a computer on wheels, and AI is moving from the cloud to the edge; right onto silicon. Our S32N automotive MPUs pack proprietary AI IP blocks that let carmakers run machine learning where it matters: in the vehicle, in real-time, safely.

We're building the next generation of our Glasgow applications team, and we want people who are **AI-native;** who reach for an LLM, a notebook, or a model before a manual. You won't just support customers; increasingly you'll be *leading* them, showing the world's biggest automotive names what's possible with our devices before they even ask.

## What you'll actually do:

* Get hands-on fast with our S32N MPUs and AI toolchains — preparing, optimising and deploying ML models onto real automotive hardware.
* Prototype new AI use-cases (on-device assistants, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, etc.) and turn them into demos that win designs.
* Write clean, modern software; and use AI coding assistants, CI/CD and automation as everyday tools, not afterthoughts.
* Work shoulder-to-shoulder with global customers and our worldwide engineering teams, becoming the technical voice that shapes how our AI silicon gets used.
* Bring fresh thinking. If there's a faster, smarter, more automated way; then we want you to find it and share it!

The Global Valuation team at Pacific Life Re is responsible for the actuarial valuation of our diverse lines of business across multiple markets and legal entities. Reporting to the Group CIO, this role will treat the organization as a living, evolving product — designing, building, and continuously improving a seamless digital operating model powered by intelligent automation that reduces friction for employees and delivers a world-class customer experience.

* Track and improve internal digital satisfaction metrics.

* Drive intelligent automation, conversational AI, and self-service capabilities.

* Strengthen cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and compliance frameworks with built-in AI safety and risk safeguards.

* Drive stakeholder alignment, AI literacy, and system adoption.

**Change Management**

## Description

### About Perlego

Perlego is on a mission to make education accessible to everyone. Dubbed "The Spotify for Textbooks," we give learners worldwide unlimited access to over 1.5 million ebooks and educational resources from 9,000+ leading publishers, and we partner with hundreds of universities, businesses, and training providers to put a library in every learner's pocket. More recently we've expanded beyond the textbook into leisure reading, bringing best-selling fiction, non-fiction, professional and general-interest books onto the same subscription, so the person who came to us for their course reading now has somewhere to go when the term ends. Students, professionals and curious readers in over 100 countries read on Perlego every day, across web, iOS and Android, and the experience they have once they're inside the product is what this role is about.

### The role

The Platform Experience (PEX) squad is the custodian of the Perlego user experience after a user has signed up. The squad aims to make every user’s experience a delight — whether that be finding their next book, organising their digital bookshelves or reading a book on the Perlego web or mobile eReader.

As the Product Manager in PEX you’ll be working on bets such as consolidating our book search and recommendations features, developing relevant and useful AI tools for students and overhauling our mobile eReader. You will own the discovery, shaping, proposal and delivery of bets in the Platform Experience squad end to end and you will connect the work to the numbers the squad is judged on.

## Requirements

### **Who you are**

* 2+ years owning product. You have shipped things that changed a number, and you can say which number and by how much.
* Experience in building habit forming experiences and driving weekly and monthly engagement metrics.
* Genuinely quantitative. There is no dedicated Data Analyst attached to your squad, so you need to be comfortable with digging in to data and BI tools. You can read an experiment result, and you can size an opportunity yourself.
* You brief engineers and designers and the brief holds up under questioning. Scope, edge cases, and what is deliberately out and a clear rationale for why.
* You talk to users regularly, and you use what you hear to shape what you build rather than to validate it afterwards.
* You make trade-offs and say what you traded away. Ambiguity is the normal operating condition here, not a problem to be escalated.

**This is not a backlog management role.** Nobody will hand you a prioritised list. You build it, defend it, and own what happens.

### What you will own:

* Analysing and synthesising quantitative and qualitative evidence, and communicating what it means
* Placing the impact of the work in company context: which squad KPI moves, roughly how much, and why that matters
* Briefing engineers, designers and copywriters, with light review
* Stakeholder engagement on your bets, seeking input and and supporting decisions with evidence
* Building understanding of users, the industry and the squad’s problem space
* Applying the agreed product tools and methods with limited support

### How we work

Perlego is organised into cross-functional squads, each grouped under a layer of the business and each accountable for a small set of KPIs. Squads are made up of Product, Engineering, Design, QA and Data, and they own their problem space rather than a feature list.

We work in bets. A bet is a clearly stated hypothesis about how to move a squad KPI, with the evidence behind it, the scope, and what has deliberately been left out. Bets are proposed by the squad, reviewed in a company-wide roadmap cycle, and then delivered by the squad that proposed them. Most bets are sized to ship and read within a quarter. Occasionally we commit to a bold bet, a larger piece of work that cuts across squads and gets its own team for a period.

We work in the open. Discovery notes, decision logs and weekly progress updates live in Notion where anyone in the company can read them. We expect people to bring evidence rather than opinion, to say what they traded away when they made a call, and to raise risks themselves rather than wait for them to surface. Product leadership reviews and challenges the work; it does not hand down the answer.

We're a hybrid team based in London, and squads set their own rhythm within that.

**Your part in it.** You run discovery and delivery for your bets with a Product Lead or Head of Product reviewing rather than directing. You bring your squad’s input into the roadmap cycle. You log weekly progress and flag your own risks. Secondment to a bold bet is possible.

# Senior Azure Developer / Azure Technical Consultant

**About the role**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Azure Developer / Azure Technical Consultant to support the ongoing development, evolution and technical improvement of enterprise applications hosted in Microsoft Azure. **ROLE SUMMARY**

Our Global Cyber Defense team is responsible for safeguarding Pfizer's digital assets and infrastructure through proactive threat detection, incident response, and risk mitigation across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

As a Lead Threat Response Operations Analyst within Pfizer’s Global Cyber Defense organization, you will serve as a senior individual contributor, providing technical leadership for the investigation and response to sophisticated cyber threats. While this is not a people-management role, you will lead complex investigations, coordinate the response to security incidents on a global scale, and provide technical guidance to analysts and partner teams. You will bring deep expertise in cyber threat analysis, incident response, malware investigations and adversary tradecraft, with the ability to operate confidently across complex business and technical environments.

Working alongside Threat Detection, Digital Forensics, Security Engineering and other partner teams, you will identify, contain and eradicate threats while providing strategic recommendations to strengthen Pfizer’s cyber resilience.

**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Correlate and analyse security telemetry from endpoint, identity, network, cloud, email and threat intelligence sources to identify, investigate and respond to malicious activity.
* Apply knowledge of adversary tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs) to reconstruct attack lifecycles, determine attack pathways, identify root cause and develop strategic detection and mitigation recommendations.
* Lead the assessment of cyber security incidents, determining severity, business impact, threat scope, and appropriate response and escalation actions.
* Apply advanced knowledge of networking, operating systems and security architectures to analyse technical evidence, identify attack vectors and guide effective containment, eradication and remediation actions.
* Communicate complex technical findings, incident impacts, response decisions and remediation recommendations clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement of Threat Response processes, investigation methodologies, operational procedures, reporting standards, and playbooks to enhance the effectiveness and maturity of the cyber incident response capability
* Co-ordinate effectively across technical and business teams to coordinate cyber incident response activities, maintaining professionalism and sound judgement during high-pressure situations.
* Lead complex cyber security projects and cross-functional workstreams, ensuring timely delivery of objectives and operational improvements.  
  Support the triage of cyber security tickets, providing technical guidance on priority, scope, investigation, escalation and appropriate response actions.
* Provide technical guidance, coaching and knowledge sharing to analysts and partner teams to strengthen investigation quality and Threat Response capability.
* Participate in a scheduled on-call rotation, including weekends, providing timely response, investigation, escalation, and coordination of cyber security incidents.
* Maintain and continuously develop technical expertise in cyber security, threat response, and emerging attack techniques through ongoing training, research, and professional development.

 

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in cyber security, computer forensics, computer science, Information Security, Information Systems, Engineering, Sciences or related field.
* Some relevant experience in cyber security operations, incident response or threat investigation, with demonstrated experience leading complex investigations.
* Advanced understanding of TCP/IP, network protocols and traffic flows, operating systems, cloud and identity technologies, enterprise security architectures and defence-in-depth principles.
* Advanced knowledge of Windows operating systems, system administration, security controls, native utilities and investigative artefacts.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse and correlate large volumes of security log data using security information and event management (SIEM) platforms, such as CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM, Splunk, Google SecOps and draw accurate, evidence-based conclusions.
* Experience using endpoint detection and response (EDR) platforms, such as CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or VMware Carbon Black, to investigate malicious activity, analyse endpoint telemetry and support incidentcontainment and remediation.
* Experience using security analysis and investigation tools such as Wireshark, Snort, Splunk, Kali Linux, SIFT Workstation, REMnux and Volatility or comparable commercial and open-source technologies, including tools used for memory forensics and malware analysis.
* Advanced understanding of the life cycle of network threats, attacks, attack vectors and methods of exploitation with an understanding of intrusion set tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs)
* Demonstrated ability to analyse and resolve complex technical problems, working independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
* Maintain and continuously develop technical expertise in cyber security, threat response and emerging attack techniques through ongoing training, research and professional development.
* Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, together with demonstrated organisational and planning abilities and the capacity to coordinate multiple complex investigations and workstreams simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to present to a variety of internal audiences including senior executives.
* Demonstrated experience leading and delivering complex cyber security projects and cross-functional workstreams, achieving both short-term objectives and longer-term operational improvements.
* Practical experience using the Linux command line to support security investigations, data analysis and the operation of cyber security tools.

**Preferred qualification:**

* Participation in practical cyber security exercises, such as red team and blue team simulations, capture-the-flag challenges, cyber ranges or incident response exercises.
* Experience using scripting or programming languages, such as Python or PowerShell, to support security investigations, analyse security data and automate repetitive tasks.

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is responsible for driving adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion within a defined portfolio of customers. You will act as the primary post‐sales relationship owner, orchestrating the right resources across Support, Product, Services, and Sales to ensure customers achieve their desired outcomes and view us as a strategic partner.

#### Key Responsibilities

#### 1. Customer Outcomes & Revenue

* Own customer health, retention, and risk management for your portfolio, in partnership with Sales and Renewals.
* Build, maintain, and execute customer success plans for priority accounts, with clear business outcomes, milestones, and owners.
* Proactively identify renewal and churn risk, create save plans, and track mitigation activities.
* Surface and qualify expansion opportunities (cross‐sell, up‐sell, use‐case expansion) and collaborate with Sales/Account Management to progress them.

#### 2. Adoption & Value Realisation

* Translate customer objectives into measurable outcomes and ensure progress is tracked and communicated.
* Regularly review usage data, health scores, and telemetry to spot gaps, drive adoption plays, and prevent value erosion.
* Deliver value‐focused reviews (e.g., Success Plan /EBRs), telling a clear story that connects product usage to business results.

#### 3. Customer Engagement & Advocacy

* Build and maintain strong, trust‐based relationships with day‐to‐day contacts, project owners, and business sponsors.
* Run a structured cadence of check‐ins, workshops, and governance reviews, tailored to customer segment and lifecycle stage.
* Capture and share customer feedback, ensuring issues are followed through to resolution and learnings are socialized internally.
* Identify and develop customer advocates for references, testimonials, case studies, and events.

#### 4. Operational Excellence & Tooling

* Keep customer records accurate and up‐to‐date in CS tools and CRM (health scores, notes, success plans, risks, and actions).
* Use standardized playbooks and processes for adoption, development, and renewal preparation.
* Prepare and maintain account success plans that give leadership clear visibility into status, risk, and opportunity.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of CS processes, templates, and best practices.

#### 5. Cross‐Functional Collaboration

* Partner with Sales/Account Executives on account strategy, renewal preparation, and executive engagement.
* Work with Support and Engineering to manage escalations, communicate status to customers, and prevent repeat issues.
* Collaborate with Product Management and CS Architecture/Onboarding to share customer insights and influence roadmap and enablement.
* Coordinate with Professional Services on project scoping, delivery alignment, and handoffs.

#### Required Experience & Skills

* Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, or similar customer‐facing role in B2B SaaS / enterprise software.
* Proven track record managing a portfolio of mid‐ to large‐enterprise customers and delivering against retention targets.
* Strong understanding of subscription / recurring revenue models and the drivers of churn and expansion.
* Ability to engage confidently with technical and non‐technical stakeholders (from admins to Director/VP level).
* Comfortable working with data and dashboards (usage, health, NPS/CSAT) and turning insights into clear actions.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.
* Strong organization and time management, with the ability to prioritize across multiple accounts and workstreams.

#### Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM), security, or adjacent enterprise SaaS.
* Hands‐on experience with Customer Success platforms (e.g., Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero) and CRM (e.g., Salesforce).
* Experience running QBRs/EBRs and building structured success plans.
* Exposure to working with distributed / global teams.

#### Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Customer Success Manager will be measured on a combination of:

* **Renewal Rate** for assigned accounts.
* **Net Revenue Retention (NRR)** / expansion pipeline influenced or sourced.
* **Portfolio health**: average health score, coverage and freshness of success plans,
* **Strategic Touchpoint Delivery** - EBR’s, Value Unlocks, Road Maps, Success Plan Reviews..
* **Customer advocacy and satisfaction**: NPS/CSAT scores, references, and participation in marketing/customer programs.
* **Operational excellence**: data quality in systems, timely updates, and adherence to core CS processes.

#### Behaviours & Values

* **Customer‐obsessed:** consistently acts in the best interest of the customer and their outcomes.
* **Data‐informed:** uses metrics and evidence to guide decisions and prioritization.
* **Collaborative:** works openly with peers and partners, sharing information and removing silos.
* **Accountable:** owns commitments, communicates proactively, and follows through.
* **Growth mindset:** seeks feedback, learns quickly, and adapts to change.

# Security Operations Lead

River Island is a UK high-street and omnichannel apparel retailer trading across 1800+ stores, a major distribution centre, head offices, and a growing ecommerce platform. As the business modernises its digital footprint, it is strengthening in-house security operations capability to complement its existing outsourced Security Operations Centre (SOC).

The **Security Operations Lead** owns day-to-day security operations delivery and acts as the primary internal control point across both **first-line** (operational security execution and tooling) and **second-line** (oversight, assurance, and governance of the security control environment) accountabilities. This is a hybrid, hands-on role suited to someone who can both operate security tooling directly and hold a third-party SOC provider to account against contracted service levels and outcomes.

The role sits within a lean Information Security function and is central to River Island's ability to detect, triage, and respond to threats across stores, ecommerce (including Storefront API/headless platforms), distribution, and corporate estate — while managing the operational relationship with the outsourced SOC.  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

**1. Security Operations Delivery**

* Own the operational delivery of security monitoring, detection, and response capability across corporate, retail, distribution, and ecommerce environments.
* Act as the internal escalation and coordination point for security alerts, incidents, and investigations raised by the outsourced SOC, ensuring timely triage and remediation.
* Operate and tune in-house security tooling (e.g. vulnerability scanning, endpoint detection, exposure management, identity/access monitoring) to complement SOC-delivered detection.
* Lead incident response execution: contain, investigate, and coordinate recovery for security incidents, following documented playbooks, and drive post-incident lessons-learned activity.
* Coordinate vulnerability management end-to-end — from detection and prioritisation through to remediation tracking with Technology, Ecommerce, and Infrastructure teams.
* Support patching, hardening, and configuration management activities across store systems, cloud platforms, and the ecommerce stack.
* Maintain and test incident response runbooks, tabletop exercises, and escalation paths, including out-of-hours coverage arrangements with the SOC.

**2. Outsourced SOC Management and Oversight**

* Act as the primary relationship and performance owner for the outsourced SOC provider, holding them accountable to SLAs, use-case coverage, detection efficacy, and reporting quality.
* Chair or contribute to regular SOC service reviews, tracking key metrics such as mean time to detect (MTTD), mean time to respond (MTTR), false-positive rates, alert volumes, and coverage gaps.
* Define and continuously refine detection use cases and log source onboarding with the SOC to ensure coverage keeps pace with the retail estate, ecommerce releases, and cloud changes.
* Provide independent assurance that SOC-reported findings, incident closures, and control effectiveness claims are accurate and evidenced — challenging and validating rather than simply accepting vendor reporting.
* Own the governance of the SOC contract from a security-operations lens: reviewing scope, escalation matrices, data handling, and change requests as the business or threat landscape evolves.
* Ensure clear ownership of assets, logs, and detection logic remains with River Island, avoiding vendor lock-in or loss of institutional knowledge.
* Feed SOC performance, risk exposure, and control gaps into the Information Security Risk Register and executive/committee reporting.

**3. Governance, Risk, and Reporting**

* Define and report security operations KPIs/KRIs (detection coverage, incident volumes and trends, remediation SLAs, SOC performance) to the Head of Information Security and relevant governance forums (e.g. GDPR Steering Committee, security committees).
* Support compliance activities across PCI DSS, UK GDPR, and ISO 27001/NIST CSF-aligned control requirements as they relate to operational security and monitoring.
* Maintain evidence and documentation to support internal and external audits, penetration tests, and regulatory reviews.
* Partner with Legal, DPO, and Risk teams on incident notification obligations and data breach response.

**4. Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Work closely with Ecommerce/Storefront API, Infrastructure, Retail Technology, and Distribution Centre teams to ensure monitoring coverage extends across all channels — stores, web, app, and warehouse systems.
* Partner with the security and tech Engineers on penetration testing, red-teaming, and remediation coordination.
* Support BYOD/MDM security monitoring and access governance activities (RBAC, joiner/mover/leaver, MFA, privileged access, Identity posture) from an operational assurance standpoint.
* Represent security operations in change advisory and project forums to ensure new initiatives are onboarded into monitoring scope pre-go-live.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* Proven experience in a security operations, SOC management, or similar hands-on operational security role, ideally within retail, ecommerce, or another complex multi-channel environment.
* Demonstrable experience managing or governing an outsourced/managed SOC or MSSP relationship, including SLA management and detection use-case development.
* Strong working knowledge of SIEM, EDR, vulnerability management, and exposure management tooling.
* Practical incident response experience, including leading or coordinating live incident investigations.
* Familiarity with the three lines of defence model and ability to operate credibly across both first-line delivery and second-line oversight.
* Understanding of PCI DSS, UK GDPR, and NIST CSF control frameworks as applied to operational security.
* Comfortable working in a lean team, prioritising pragmatically, and balancing protection with business/customer experience.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, able to challenge a third-party provider constructively while maintaining an effective working relationship.

**Desirable**

* Experience securing ecommerce/headless commerce platforms (e.g. Shopify, Storefront APIs) or retail store estates.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH, or equivalent.
* Experience with retail-specific threats (POS malware, card-skimming, credential stuffing, loyalty/gift card fraud).
* Exposure to cloud-native security monitoring (Azure/AWS/GCP) and CI/CD pipeline security.

* Confidence participating in code reviews and explaining technical decisions clearly.
* The ability to take ownership of work from a well-scoped ticket through to production, including testing, documentation, monitoring and follow-through.

* Experience working with multi-tenant systems, row-level access controls, PII or GDPR-sensitive data.
* Experience supporting a migration from legacy reporting or BI technology to a governed, modern data platform.

## 🤝 How you’ll work

* You use AI-assisted delivery thoughtfully, validating generated code and tests before they become part of the product.
* You favour simple solutions, evaluate existing libraries and services before building new ones, and avoid unnecessary complexity.

# Head of Analysis & Design - Investment Platform

London, United Kingdom

## Job Description

**Who we’re looking for**

We are seeking a high-calibre, hands-on Head of Analysis & Design to lead our team of senior Analysts and support the evolution of our business architecture across our Public Markets Investment Platform.

This role is pivotal in ensuring that enterprise strategy, operating models, and cross-domain business capabilities are clearly defined, aligned, and translated into scalable platform outcomes.

You will operate at the intersection of business strategy, investment domain expertise, product management, solution design and technology delivery, ensuring business priorities are translated into scalable platform outcomes across Public Markets while remaining aligned to wider Asset Management Platform standards and objectives.

As a senior leader, you will lead and develop the Public Markets Analysis & Design capability, embedding strong business analysis, solution design and product thinking disciplines that drive measurable business value, effective delivery and continuous improvement.

The role acts as the primary bridge between Public Markets business stakeholders, product management, architecture and engineering teams. Whilst engineering teams may operate under separate reporting structures, the Head of Analysis & Design remains accountable for ensuring analysis, solution design and technology delivery remain closely aligned through active participation in technology governance, planning and design forums.

**About Us**

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.

Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.

**The team**

The Asset Management Platform (AMP) is a global technology change and delivery organisation responsible for the platforms that underpin Schroders’ investment, client and operational capabilities across public and private markets

AMP brings together a set of business-aligned technology platforms—including Client, Investment, Group Operations, Data and Finance—into a single, integrated asset management capability, enabling consistent, scalable and value-driven outcomes across the firm.

Operating within a platform-centric model, teams are aligned to business outcomes while leveraging shared enterprise capabilities across architecture, data, engineering and delivery to drive standardisation, reuse, and speed of execution.

**Asset Management Platform – Analysis & Design**

The Analysis & Design function is a core enterprise level capability within the Asset Management Platform, accountable for shaping the future direction of the firm's technology and business capabilities. 

Operating across all business aligned domains, the team provides leadership in business analysis, architecture, operating model design, strategic analysis and product management, ensuring investment is aligned to business priorities and enterprise outcomes. 

Through the definition of common standards, reusable design patterns and platform-wide governance, the function drives consistency, simplification and scalability, enabling the organisation to accelerate change, optimise cost, and realise the full potential of data, AI and platform-based operating models.

**Analysis & Design plays a central role in achieving this by:**

* Defining enterprise-wide capability models and value streams
* Ensuring alignment across platforms and business domains
* Driving standardisation, simplification, and convergence
* Enabling data - and AI-driven transformation at scale

The Head of Analysis will provide the structural backbone linking strategy to execution, ensuring that business intent is consistently realised across the platform ecosystem.

**What you’ll do**

* Lead the Analysis & Design strategy for Public Markets, ensuring Public Markets products, platforms and technology investments align with Asset Management Platform standards, enterprise architecture principles and strategic objectives.
* Ensure Public Markets products, platforms and investments remain aligned with Asset Management Platform strategy, standards and architecture.
* Lead, develop and grow the Public Markets Analysis & Design team, establishing high standards, clear career pathways and a culture of continuous improvement.
* Partner with business stakeholders across research, portfolio management, trading and investment operations to shape strategic priorities and transformation initiatives.
* Define and evolve business capabilities, operating models and business processes across Public Markets, ensuring clear alignment between strategy, execution and technology outcomes.
* Translate business strategy into clear requirements, high level designs and delivery outcomes that create measurable business value.
* Partner with Product Leads, Engineering Leads and Architects to shape backlogs, govern solution design and ensure Public Markets technology outcomes align with business priorities, architectural standards and Asset Management Platform objectives.
* Maintain strong engagement with engineering leadership and participate in technology planning, governance and architecture forums to ensure business analysis and solution design remain closely integrated with technology delivery.
* Act as the bridge between business, product, architecture and engineering teams, driving alignment and effective decision-making across complex initiatives.
* Drive simplification, standardisation and continuous improvement across investment processes and ways of working.
* Establish and continuously improve business analysis and solution design standards, methodologies and governance across Public Markets.
* Identify capability gaps, inefficiencies and transformation opportunities across the investment lifecycle.
* Embed data, analytics and AI considerations into business processes and solution design, identifying opportunities to improve investment outcomes, operational efficiency and user experience.
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Investments, Technology and Change to influence decisions and drive strategic outcomes.
* Contribute to the wider Analysis & Design, Architecture and Asset Management Platform communities, promoting consistency, collaboration and best practice.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise strategies and standards

**The knowledge, experience and qualifications you need**

* Proven experience leading Business Analysis, Analysis & Design or related functions within a complex, global organisation.
* Strong understanding of Public Markets and asset management business processes, including research, portfolio management, trading and investment operations.
* Experience building, developing and leading high-performing teams of Business Analysts and Analysis & Design professionals.
* Strong understanding of business architecture, operating model design, business capability modelling and end-to-end process improvement.
* Experience operating within platform-led, product-based or agile delivery organisations.
* Proven ability to translate business strategy into clear outcomes, roadmaps and deliverable change initiatives.
* Experience partnering with Product, Engineering and Architecture teams to shape and deliver technology-enabled business transformation.
* Strong understanding of modern technology concepts, including platform architectures, data ecosystems, integration patterns and AI-enabled solutions.
* Experience ensuring business outcomes, product direction and technology delivery remain aligned with enterprise strategy, architecture and platform standards
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and build strong relationships across business and technology functions.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and articulate a clear strategic direction.
* Experience leading large-scale business, data and AI-enabled transformation initiatives that deliver measurable business value.

**What you’ll be like**

The successful candidate will be a strategic and outcome‐driven senior Analyst, able to connect business priorities with clear, scalable technology direction. They will combine strong vision with pragmatism—defining long‐term platform strategy while making practical decisions that enable delivery at pace. With deep analytical credibility, they will engage confidently across analysis, architecture, engineering and delivery teams, shaping solutions that are robust, aligned to enterprise standards and focused on delivering tangible business value.

They will operate as a collaborative and influential leader within a complex, global environment, driving alignment across business and technology stakeholders. A strong advocate of simplification, standardisation and reuse, they will actively reduce complexity and drive convergence across the platform. Clear in their communication and accountable in their approach, they will take ownership for the platform’s evolution, contribute to the wider analysis and design community, and continuously apply emerging technologies—particularly data and AI—to enhance investment capabilities and outcomes.

An experienced people leader who develops high-performing analytical teams through coaching, mentoring and continuous improvement.

A collaborative leader who brings together business, product, engineering and architecture stakeholders to achieve shared outcomes.

Comfortable operating strategically while remaining hands-on where required to resolve ambiguity, shape complex initiatives and support delivery teams.

## Job description

**Contract:** Initial 6 months   
 **Rate:** Outside IR35  
 **Security clearance requirements:** BPSS level

Storm ID is an award-winning Edinburgh-based digital transformation consultancy that helps organisations accelerate their use of digital, data and AI. We believe in tailored solutions, assembling expert teams to address each client's unique needs. Our services span strategy, design, technology and data & AI, ensuring seamless end-to-end delivery of platforms, products and services with real-world impact.

## Role Overview

Storm ID has delivered the Alpha phase of a prominent Scottish Government digital transformation programme. The work is focused on shaping and validating an end-to-end service model, including service mapping, early-stage integration activity and the development of an initial working capability within a secure test environment.

The programme includes multiple related delivery streams being delivered by a mixed supplier and Scottish Government team. These streams cover user-facing digital journeys, supporting content and information architecture, and the underpinning service model and technical approach required to enable future phases.

That architecture is documented in both a PoC High Level Design and Full-Service High-Level Design, supported by Architecture Decision Records. The next phase requires:

* one or more iterations of the Full Service HLD based on a re-evaluation of technical and integration constraints.
* a body of options papers and ADRs that show the reasoning, alternatives and trade-offs behind each decision before the decision is written up.
* integration strategies for each justice partner that are specific to that partner's systems, appetite and supplier landscape.
* low level design of sufficient depth to assure, cost, plan and build a Beta.

## Essential skills and experience

* Substantial experience as a technical architect on complex, integration-heavy digital services, with a track record of designs that were successfully delivered.
* Demonstrable ownership of HLD and LLD artefacts through multiple iterations and formal architectural assurance, in a governed public sector or comparably regulated environment.
* Deep, practical systems integration expertise: event-driven and message-based architecture, service buses, asynchronous patterns, idempotency, replay, dead-lettering, eventual consistency, change data capture and reconciliation.
* Strong API design and integration with legacy and third-party systems that you do not control and cannot change.
* Data architecture: modelling, entity correlation and matching across systems without shared identifiers, data quality, migration and seeding, retention and deletion.
* Cloud architecture on Azure — networking, identity, data services, messaging, secrets, IaC and CI/CD; ability to size and cost a workload.
* Security and privacy by design: authentication and identity (OIDC/OAuth2, federated identity), threat modelling, data protection and information governance for sensitive personal data.
* Written argument. Options papers, ADRs and design documents that a sceptical technical reviewer can follow and act on.
* Stakeholder credibility. Able to hold a design position under sustained challenge from an assurance function, concede accurately when the challenge is right, and negotiate with partner organisations whose interests are not aligned with the programme's.

## 

**Desirable skills and experience**

* Experience in the justice, policing or public safety sector
* Familiarity with Scottish Government common components; ScotAccount, Digital Mailbox, SG Cloud Platform, Scottish Government Design System and the Digital Scotland Service Standard.
* Experience designing services for vulnerable users
* Experience with viewpoint-based architecture description (Rozanski & Woods or similar) and with C4 or equivalent modelling.
* Multi-organisation programme experience where architectural progress depends on organisational agreement
