We offer a unique surveillance-as-a-service solution that delivers real-time intelligence, enhancing maritime safety and saving lives. Our products and services support strategic and operational decisions in the most demanding environments — whether at sea, on land, in space, or in cyberspace.

Become part of a dynamic, multidisciplinary, and mission-driven team that is transforming maritime surveillance and redefining global safety standards.

At TEKEVER, our mission is to provide limitless support through mission-oriented game-changers, delivering the right information at the right time to empower critical decision-making.

If you're passionate about technology and eager to shape the future — TEKEVER is the place for you.

##### **Mission**

To own and drive risk and opportunity management across major Civil & Defence projects. The role is responsible for establishing and running the Risk and Opportunity Register, applying risk methodology and risk scoring and providing the Programme Director/SRO, Programme Manager and Chief Engineer with clear visibility, analysis and mitigation of programme, technical, regulatory, commercial and supply chain risk throughout delivery. The post holder will bring proven risk management experience from complex Defence, Aerospace and Engineering programmes, and the ability to work across programme, engineering, safety, commercial and supply chain disciplines to keep risk visible, owned and actively managed.

##### The Role:

###### Risk & Opportunity Management

1. Establish, own and maintain the Risk and Opportunity function.

2. Apply Risk methodology and risk scoring to classify, score and actively manage every risk, ensuring all has dedicated resource from across the organisation.

3. Facilitate risk identification workshops across programme, engineering, safety, commercial, supply chain and training functions, capturing new risks and opportunities as Projects progress.

4. Track mitigation actions to closure, escalating risks that exceed agreed tolerance thresholds to the Programme Manager and Programme Director/SRO.

###### Governance, Reporting & Assurance

1. Own risk and opportunity reporting into the Performance Review Meeting (PRM), Programme Board and Authority reporting cycle.

2. Maintain the Decision Log and supporting risk documentation, ensuring a clear audit trail of risk decisions and approvals.

3. Support programme controls (the PCMP and CWBS) by ensuring cost, schedule and quality risk are reflected in the integrated programme schedules and budgets.

4. Provide risk input into functional areas across the business.

###### Regulatory, Safety & Technical Risk Coordination

1. Coordinate with the Chief Engineer, Safety Manager and Airworthiness Lead to track engineering, safety and certification risk, including SAIL/OSO compliance, MRP adherence, and Design Organisation conformity across the UK/Portugal boundary.

2. Track integration and security risk associated with spiral development requirements, escalating critical-path issues to the Chief Engineer when required.

3. Track supply chain and production risk, including manufacturing readiness at WWA and Swindon, supplier lead times and single points of failure, working with the Supply Chain Lead and the Manufacturing, Assembly & Integration Lead.

4. Track commercial and IP risk, including contract change impact and Design Authority/IP transfer decisions, working with the Commercial Lead.

###### Internal Collaboration

1. Work closely with the Programme Manager and Programme Controls Manager to keep the Risk and Opportunity Register aligned with the wider programme schedule, budget and change control processes.

2. Support the Programme Director/SRO in preparing risk positions ahead of Authority engagement and negotiation.

3. Coach risk owners across the Delivery team in applying risk ensuring consistent approach across the business.

4. As is consistent with a scaling company, support work outside of core responsibilities where business priorities require. Tekever uses an Agile methodology that requires its workforce to adapt to changing work demands.

##### Competencies

**Qualifications & Training**

* Relevant professional experience in risk management, programme controls or project management within defence, aerospace or a comparable complex engineering sector.

* Formal risk management qualification (e.g. APM Risk, M\_o\_R, IRM) or equivalent.

* Undergraduate degree or equivalent professional experience in a relevant discipline.

**Experience**

* Proven experience establishing and running a risk on a complex programme, including risk identification, scoring, mitigation tracking and escalation.

* Experience reporting risk to senior governance boards and external customers/authorities.

* Experience with UK MOD or equivalent Defence procurement and governance.

* Experience on UAS, ISR or aerospace programmes involving multi-entity Design Authority arrangements.

**Product / Domain Knowledge**

* Understanding of risk management frameworks and tools (e.g. risk registers, probability/impact scoring, RAID logs) and the ability to apply them practically rather than passively.

* Familiarity with UAS/ISR systems, airworthiness and safety case concepts (MAA, SAIL/OSO, Def Stan 00-56).

* Familiarity with programme controls disciplines (CWBS, PCMP, earned value management).

**What we have to offer you:**

At TEKEVER, we offer a comprehensive package designed to reward, support, and develop our people. This includes a highly competitive salary with a discretionary annual bonus and a company pension contribution match of up to 10%. To support your wellbeing, we provide 25 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays, Private Medical Insurance (with optional family cover), Private Dental care, and an Employee Assistance Programme. We are deeply committed to investing in future talent; our scale allows us to provide clear career development opportunities and dedicated initiatives to boost your skill sets, ensuring you remain future-ready for the evolving workplace. Furthermore, our team enjoys a flexible hybrid working model, typically three days a week at our core UK sites like Bristol, and access to a bespoke rewards platform featuring a variety of high street discounts and salary sacrifice schemes, including Electric Car, Cycle to Work, and Technology options.

OverviewApplication

**📈 Who We Are:**

**We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.**

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a **$75 million Series B -** led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

# 🏅 The Role:

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer to join Origination & New Products, a new three-person squad inside Sell Side Growth.

Sell Side Growth originates, contracts, and retains the renewable generators whose volume powers our platform - without generators, there's no product. The engine is scaling fast, and much of the manual process underneath today's pipeline - tendering, contracting, onboarding - needs to be rebuilt to handle that growth rather than buckle under it.

This is a deep, hands-on IC role, not a squad-lead one - that's owned by the Staff/Senior Staff engineer leading the initiative. You're free to go all-in on the hardest technical problems: integration with Rosso (our pricing and settlement engine), Control Room (our core tendering and pipeline platform), and the deal-gating risk tooling that lets us take on genuinely new categories of commercial risk safely. We're not hiring for leadership polish here. We're hiring a ridiculously good engineer.

**In your first 12 months, you might:**

* Own architecture-level decisions on the integration-heavy systems connecting Origination & New Products to Rosso, Data, and Billing.
* Help ship the first new product category live and generating qualified pipeline within 6 months.
* Help solve the tendering automation problem that currently limits how much volume the team can quote on - one of the highest-leverage levers for supporting our growth.
* Contribute to productising a currently manual, error-prone pricing process that's already turning away large, complex deals.
* Design deal-gating risk tooling for commercial risk categories that don't exist yet at tem, within our React/TypeScript and Python/AWS serverless stack.

# 🚀 Responsibilities:

* **Go deep on hard systems:** Own architecture-level decisions on integration-heavy systems, reasoning clearly about boundaries, contracts, and failure modes.
* **Build for ambiguity:** Take a piece of an undefined, commercially-driven problem and turn it into a shippable plan, within the direction your squad lead sets.
* **Work across boundaries:** Deliver on dependencies that sit with teams you have no authority over, such as Rosso, Data, and Billing, getting integrations right without needing to own the relationship.
* **Build with impact:** Design, build, and ship the hardest parts of the new-product build sequence yourself, backend-first but comfortable moving into the React/TypeScript front end when it matters.
* **Maintain high standards:** Write clean, well-tested code, contribute to code reviews, and help improve team practices and documentation.

# 🎯 Requirements:

**Must-Haves:**

* Deep technical depth in backend and systems design, with a track record of owning architecture-level decisions on complex, integration-heavy systems.
* Comfortable in our core stack: Python, AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EventBridge), and event-driven architectures. React/TypeScript exposure is a plus but not the bar.
* Comfort operating without a full spec: able to take a defined slice of an ambiguous problem and turn it into a shippable plan.
* Experience delivering work where a critical dependency sits with a team you have no authority over.
* Proven product delivery experience: experience as a Full Stack or Backend Engineer in a startup or fast-paced product environment, with ownership of complex projects from start to finish.

**Desirable:**

* Prior experience mentoring engineers or setting technical direction, even without a formal leadership title. Not required. We'd rather have a brilliant engineer who has never led a squad than a mediocre one who has.
* Experience in energy, fintech, or another regulated, high-stakes commercial domain.
* Exposure to workflow orchestration, event-driven systems, or real-time pricing engines.
* Experience originating new product lines from scratch rather than only scaling existing ones.

# ✨ Benefits & Perks:

* **Competitive salar**y - our current band for this role is £104,000 or equivalent in local currency.

  + We pay against a clear benchmark for your role and level. No fixed once- or twice-a-year cycle - pay moves when the evidence for it does.
* **Stock Options** - everyone on the team has ownership in our mission.
* **25 days holiday + public holidays** - Swap public holidays for ones that matter most to you. Plus, get an extra day off for your birthday 🎉.
* **Remote & flexible working** - We’re fully remote with clear core hours, and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.
* **Home working & wellbeing budgets**:

  + Up to **£1,200 / €1,200 annually** to upgrade your remote setup (co-working passes, equipment, etc.).
  + Up to **£150 / €150 monthly** on anything that supports your wellbeing - from therapy to gym memberships to meditation apps.

# 🗣️ Interview Process:

Our processes normally take around 2-3 weeks from first call to offer - please let us know about any adjustments to timelines that may be required.

1. **First call with our Talent Team (30 Mins).** This is to understand your experience, motivations, and discuss the role in more detail.
2. **Behaviour Interview with our Engineering Managers (60 Mins).** This is your chance to really understand the role, the expectations, and ensure alignment on ways of working.
3. **Technical Interview with the Team (75 Mins)**. You’ll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss technical topics and experiences.
4. **Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders (45 Mins).** The final session will be with two cross-functional stakeholders, and will explore how your values align with ours, and is designed to be a genuine two-way conversation, your chance to understand what it’s really like to work at tem.

*We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.*

The platform is expanding from orchestrating workloads on a managed cluster to owning the full stack on bare-metal GPU infrastructure: a managed Slurm scheduling layer for internal research and model-training teams first, and our own Kubernetes control plane for inference tenancy after that.

The Technical Lead owns the architecture and delivery of that stack and leads the engineering team building it: about twelve engineers across backend, frontend, DevOps, QA and documentation, distributed across Europe and India. The role reports to the Senior Technical Product Manager for Cosmic AC, who owns scope, sequencing and partner commitments; the Technical Lead owns architecture, implementation and delivery plans, line-manages the engineers, and is the primary technical interface to our infrastructure partners.

This is a hands-on infrastructure leadership role with a fixed delivery window in its first six months. It is not a research role, not a pure Kubernetes SRE role, and not a management-only role.

**Responsibilities**

**Architecture.** Own the platform architecture end to end: architecture proposals, high-level and low-level designs, driven through review and kept current as the baseline.

**Team leadership.** Lead and line-manage a distributed team across backend (Node.js), frontend (React), DevOps, QA and documentation: engineering standards, code and design review, release gates, one-to-ones, growth and performance input.

**Bare-metal GPU scheduling layer**. Design, build and operate a managed Slurm service for research users: controller and accounting, partitions and login nodes, node onboarding and acceptance, driver and CUDA baseline and upgrades, stalled-job and node-health detection, drain and autohealing, storage visibility, identity and isolation.

**Kubernetes control plane and GPU enablement.** Own cluster bootstrap and lifecycle on partner-provided bare metal, NVIDIA GPU Operator and Network Operator, VM-based GPU isolation (KubeVirt and VFIO), and day-2 operations: upgrades, backup and recovery, node replacement.

**Managed inference at scale.** Serving architecture, multi-GPU and multi-node parallelism, autoscaling, request routing and endpoint reliability; confidential-compute-capable capacity for sensitive workloads.

**Observability and operations.** Metrics, logging, alerting and SLOs across control plane, GPU fleet and application tiers; incident response and post-incident review; an on-call model a small team can sustain.

**Partners and vendors.** Primary technical interface to infrastructure partners and vendors: turning requirements into written specifications and acceptance tests, running escalations to closure, and providing technical input to capacity planning and hardware sourcing.

**Internal consumers.** Work directly with research, model-training and product teams to translate their workloads into platform requirements, and broker capacity when it is short.

**Hiring**. Complete the platform team and set the technical bar for the engineers who join it.

## Job requirements

**Must have**

* **Experience.** Eight or more years of hands-on engineering, including at least three leading teams that build and operate infrastructure platforms other teams depend on. Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Slurm at scale, hands on.** Has run slurmctld and slurmdbd for real users: partitions, QoS and priority, accounting, prolog and epilog, node health scripting, upgrades with jobs on the system. Ideally has operated an HPC or GPU training cluster for a research population.
* **GPU fleet operation on bare metal.** NVIDIA driver and CUDA lifecycle, Fabric Manager and NVSwitch behaviour on SXM systems, DCGM-based health and utilisation, MIG, node burn-in and acceptance.
* **High-performance interconnects.** InfiniBand fabric and subnet configuration, RDMA, SR-IOV, and diagnosing multi-node NCCL performance problems.
* **Linux systems depth**. Kernel modules and drivers, PCIe passthrough and vfio-pci, cgroups and namespaces, performance tuning for compute-heavy workloads.
* **Production Kubernetes operation, not just deployment:** control plane, upgrades, CNI and CSI, operators and custom controllers, multi-tenancy design.
* **HPC storage and data movement.** Shared filesystems (VAST, Lustre, NFS), node-local NVMe caching, distributing large model weights and datasets across many nodes.
* **Observability and operations.** Prometheus, Grafana and Loki or equivalents, SLOs, incident response and post-incident review.
* **Working fluency in JavaScript and Node.js** sufficient to review a control plane, CLI and worker services with authority and to make architecture decisions on them. Not a feature-development requirement.
* **A shipped platform with real users.** A multi-tenant IaaS or PaaS, or a research computing service: resource isolation, quotas, usage metering, and user-facing API and CLI surfaces.
* **Leadership that stays in the code.** People management across time zones, cross-track review, written architecture decisions with alternatives recorded, and the ability to tell a partner or an executive no with reasons.
* **Excellent written and spoken English.** Most partner and leadership work happens in writing.
* **Location**. Fully remote, based between UTC and UTC+5:30 so the working day overlaps both Europe and India, where the team and its partners work. Occasional travel to partner sites and team events.

**Desirable**

* Slurm operators on Kubernetes (Soperator, Slinky) or Kubernetes-native schedulers (Kueue, Volcano, KAI, Kubeflow Trainer).
* Modern serving stacks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM): parallelism strategies, quantisation trade-offs, GPU memory planning.
* VM and container isolation for multi-tenant GPU compute (KubeVirt, Kata Containers, QEMU and KVM, Firecracker); confidential computing (Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP, NVIDIA confidential-compute mode).
* Cluster API and kubeadm, Cilium, NVSentinel-class autohealing, infrastructure as code and GitOps.

* Time on the operator side of a GPU cloud, a national or university HPC centre, or an AI lab's platform team.
* Peer-to-peer or distributed-systems background.
* Experience with a hardware provider who provisions but does not operate, and turning that relationship into a written contract with acceptance tests.

### About You

You’ll likely be an established PMO, programme or project delivery professional who enjoys bringing structure to busy environments but also wants the opportunity to influence how things are done.

You’ll be comfortable working with project managers, technical teams, workstream leads and senior stakeholders, and confident enough to ask questions, challenge constructively and make sure actions, risks and dependencies are properly followed through.

You’ll understand that different teams may use different delivery methodologies and will be comfortable working alongside **Agile teams**, helping connect their delivery activity into the wider programme and portfolio view without imposing unnecessary process.

You’ll also be pragmatic. We want consistent governance and good project controls, but not unnecessary bureaucracy.

You won’t be expected to arrive and build a PMO completely from scratch. Instead, we want someone who can operate the framework effectively, identify where it could work better and bring relevant ideas and experience from other environments.

### About The Role

We’re looking for an experienced **PMO & Delivery Analyst** to play a key role in improving how projects are governed, reported and delivered across the organisation.

We are currently introducing a more consistent project framework across the business, covering areas such as governance, reporting, RAID management, resource forecasting and portfolio visibility.

The framework itself will be in place, but it will still be relatively new. We therefore want someone who can take ownership of running it day-to-day, help embed it across project teams and bring ideas on how it can be improved as our delivery capability matures.

We are currently consolidating a number of smaller workstreams and project activities into fewer, larger programmes where we can apply a more consistent approach to governance, reporting and project controls.

Our delivery environment includes teams and projects working in different ways, including **Agile delivery**. An important part of the role will therefore be helping ensure projects delivered through Agile ways of working are effectively coordinated into wider programme governance, reporting, dependencies and portfolio oversight.

This isn’t a traditional PMO role focused solely on administration and reporting. Alongside portfolio oversight and governance, you’ll also have the opportunity to take on direct delivery responsibility.

The role is expected to be approximately **70% PMO and portfolio activity and 30% project delivery**, making it well suited to an established PMO professional who wants greater ownership, visibility and the opportunity to develop further delivery experience.

We’re more interested in the relevance and quality of your experience than prescribing a specific number of years.

You should have demonstrable experience working within a:

* PMO;
* Programme delivery function;
* Portfolio environment;
* Project controls function; or
* Closely related project delivery role.

You should have practical experience of supporting or operating project governance and controls, rather than solely providing administrative project support.

You should also have **experience or a good working familiarity with Agile ways of working**, and understand how Agile-delivered projects can be coordinated within wider programme governance, reporting and portfolio controls.

Previous experience improving an existing PMO framework, standardising project processes or taking ownership of smaller projects would be particularly relevant.

* Embed clear governance and project controls across the organisation.

* Experience delivering GTM and lifecycle engagement strategies
* Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills
* Strong project management capabilities within fast-paced environments
* Self-starter mentality with high ownership and accountability
* Experience working closely with Product, CRM, Finance and BI teams

* Accelerate commercial experimentation and CRM activity
* Improve visibility and forecasting of Banking Payments performance

We are a diverse and dynamic group of 12 professionals based across the United Kingdom.

We work together to drive the optimisation and execution of sophisticated seismic acquisition surveys, combining our expertise across regions to drive innovation and provide impactful results.

* Analyse historic datasets to support the optimal design of future seismic acquisition surveys.
* Support data management activities, including the handling, recording, and tracking of incoming and outgoing data.

* Supervise, guide, and mentor Seismic Acquisition Analysts.
* Contribute to product development efforts by working closely with internal development teams.

* Effective problem solving and reporting skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of individuals at all levels.
* Flexible and adaptable.

job_description:
## The role

At Wayve, you'll help deliver the value of our breakthrough autonomous-driving technology by ensuring that a core part of our it — the AI model — is released reliably, on time, and to the standard required for production.

As our Model Release Manager, you'll own how new AI models move through the full lifecycle — from hypothesis, through training, evaluation, and on-road testing, to deployment across our vehicle fleet — balancing the fast-paced, non-deterministic nature of ML with structure and disciplined release practices.

We're looking for someone pragmatic, methodical, and system-minded — someone who understands how model releases fit into the broader engineering, evaluation, and product ecosystem, and who introduces the processes and systems needed to achieve stability, clarity, and business goals. This role rewards two things together: strong release-engineering instincts, and the judgment to know where a non-deterministic, hypothesis-driven system breaks those instincts and where it doesn't. If you have the first and are hungry to build the second fast, this is worth a conversation.

**Key responsibilities:**

* **Model release planning & coordination:** Own the model release cycle, maintaining a steady and predictable cadence for shipping new models while adapting to business priorities.
* **Gating & promotion:** Define and run the gates that promote a model from hypothesis → training → evaluation → validation → deployment. Define and justify the promotion criteria that determine what ships and what is deferred — balancing performance gains, reproducibility, product requirements, safety, and integration compatibility with the onboard software stack and vehicle platform.
* **Issues management:** Drive investigations and follow-up actions on regressions, integration issues, and technical debt; manage rollback/roll-forward of model versions.
* **Bottleneck identification & improvement:** Identify constraints in the model-release process and drive improvements. Implement dashboards and KPIs for visibility, and proactively escalate gaps.
* **Process & systems building:** Understand how model releases fit into the wider system of model development, evaluation, Wayve onboard stack, and product; build processes and frameworks that support clarity, stability, and business goals.
* **Tooling & automation influence:** Partner with ML platform and integration teams to shape end-to-end automated release tooling; define requirements that improve developer experience, release efficiency, and stakeholder communication.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Work closely with ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product teams to ensure successful and stable model releases.
* **Clarity & communication:** Act as the central point of contact for model-release status, risks, and timelines, keeping stakeholders informed at the right level of detail.
* **Continuous improvement:** Run post-release reviews and drive corrective actions across teams.

## About you

In order to set you up for success as a Model Release Manager at Wayve, we're looking for the following skills and experience.

**Essential**

* 5+ years in release management, software engineering, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and release management practices, including testing strategy, system integration, branching, and versioning.
* Conceptual understanding of ML fundamentals — what training data is, the difference between training and inference, what a model version/checkpoint represents, and why model validation is probabilistic rather than pass/fail.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools (e.g. GitHub, Buildkite, CLI tools).
* Skilled at managing releases in complex, fast-moving systems.
* Comfortable operating with high ambiguity — requirements, architecture, and timelines can shift quickly, and you're able to adapt release processes and tooling as needed.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability, especially in release trade-offs involving limited or ambiguous data.
* Good communication skills, comfortable working with engineers and presenting to leadership.

**Desirable**

* Experience in AI/ML, autonomous vehicles, or robotics.
* Familiarity with MLOps methodologies and tooling.
* Experience with ML evaluation practices and tooling — especially for physical systems: simulation, model leaderboards, statistically powered experiments (e.g. A/B or shadow-mode testing).
* Awareness of model hardware and software dependencies.
* BSc or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

This is a full-time role based in our office in London. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds, so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, with time spent working from home.

The post holder will work across the Authority’s domestic abuse services, DAP victim service and Strength to Change perpetrator service.   
   
The post holder will lead and manage the frontline operational delivery of the Domestic Abuse Service (DAP) and Strength to Change team of specialist staff ensuring trauma informed, strength based, victim focused high-quality services are delivered for male and female victims / survivors across all risk levels, including high risk victims of domestic abuse and for perpetrators of domestic abuse who pose a risk to their partners / ex-partners.

They will also have responsibility and accountability for ensuring the operational delivery of high-quality support and advice services are offered and provided to the partner / ex-partners of men accessing the Strength to Change service.   
  
They will also have responsibility for providing supervision, case reviews, reflective practice, mentoring and identifying the development needs of all staff to ensure high quality support and advice services are offered and provided, including for the partners / ex-partners of men accessing the Strength to Change service.   
  
They will be responsible for overseeing policy and processes for the sharing of information between the Strength to Change male and female service provisions to ensure risk is identified and appropriate risk management strategies and complex decision making is made taking into account any adult and child safeguarding concerns. They will be responsible for escalating service level risks to the Strength to Change Operational Lead.   
  
They also will be responsible and accountable for providing supervision, case reviews, reflective practice and personal and professional development for practitioners working with male victims / survivors.  
  
The post holder will oversee and lead on training and development of both specialist staff teams ensure they have the required high-level knowledge and expertise to undertake their specialist roles. They will also ensure that both the DAP and Strength to Change specialist teams work seamlessly together to achieve the common goal of safeguarding victims and their children.   
They will participate and facilitate effective partnership working and ensure commonality of approach and adherence to policies and procedures which inform and guide service delivery. Provide professional support, information and challenge to colleagues across the partnership and advocating on behalf of victims / survivors.   
  
On a daily basis they will process all referrals received and undertake high level decision making in line with service threshold criteria and allocate to DA Practitioners according to need and level of complexity. They will liaise with referrers for high level information to be gathered and analysed to inform decision making, service options to ensure victims and their children’s needs are met  
  
They will co-ordinate and chair multi-agency meetings required to share information, pool resources and enhance partnership working, providing effective challenge and advocating on behalf of clients to ensure the needs of victims and their children are met.   
  
On a daily basis they will provide high level specialist safeguarding advice, guidance and direction to partner agency staff, including in relation to safeguarding adults and children. They will make decisions when to initiate safeguarding escalation procedures and act accordingly.  
  
They will raise awareness of domestic abuse and evidence based good practice in relation to safeguarding and service provision in this specialist and complex area of work.  
  
The post holder will lead on the delivery of high quality impactful domestic abuse training and development for internal staff across the council and external agency staff.   
  
They will project manage, oversee and facilitate group work sessions with victims / survivors or perpetrators according to their specialism, who are referred to Domestic Abuse Services from a variety of organisations, e.g. Children/ Adults Social Care, courts, health etc. and self-referrals from clients seeking support.

The post holder is expected to work in line with the Respect Practice Standards, SafeLives and women’s Aid National Service Standards for Domestic Abuse.   
  
The post holder will be expected to develop a system thinking, strengths-based solutions focussed approach to the delivery of highly specialised services for victims / survivors of domestic abuse and perpetrators.

## Job Introduction

You might think of Yorkshire Housing as 'just' a housing provider, but we're so much more than that. Yes, we own and manage nearly 20,000 homes across Yorkshire and help create places people are proud to call home, but we're also committed to making a positive difference in people's lives.

We're investing in our homes, services and people, and with increasing focus across the housing sector on damp and mould, this is a fantastic opportunity to play a key role in delivering safe, high-quality outcomes for our customers.

As our new **Damp and Mould Team Leader**, you'll lead a specialist operational team responsible for diagnosing, managing and resolving damp and mould issues across our homes. You'll have a direct impact on customer wellbeing, service performance and compliance, while supporting and developing a team committed to delivering excellent outcomes.

**Want to know more about your next challenge?**

**What will you be doing?**

Reporting into the Repairs and Maintenance function, you'll lead a team of First Responders, Multiskilled Operatives and Technical Surveyors delivering Yorkshire Housing's specialist damp and mould service. You'll be responsible for ensuring cases are managed effectively, safely and within required timescales, while maintaining a strong focus on customer experience.

You'll provide day-to-day leadership and support to your team, creating an environment where colleagues feel trusted, valued and empowered to deliver their best work. You'll identify development opportunities, provide coaching and technical guidance, and ensure the right skills and resources are available to meet service demand.

Operational performance will be a key part of your role. You'll use data, insight and reporting to monitor KPIs, identify risks and opportunities, and drive continuous improvement. You'll work closely with Resource Planning and colleagues across the business to overcome operational challenges and ensure customers receive a responsive, reliable service.

You'll also take ownership of complex customer cases and complaints, helping to achieve positive outcomes while balancing customer needs, quality standards, compliance requirements and value for money. Alongside this, you'll oversee the performance of specialist contractors and ensure all activity is delivered safely and in line with industry standards and legislation.

This is a varied role where no two days are the same. You'll be comfortable moving between operational problem-solving, people leadership, customer-focused decision making and performance management, all while helping Yorkshire Housing continually improve our approach to damp and mould management.

Already feel this is the role for you? Please check out the attached role profile for further information.

**Who are we looking for?**

We're looking for an experienced and customer-focused leader who can balance technical expertise with strong people management skills. You'll have a solid understanding of building pathology and the factors that contribute to damp, mould and condensation issues, with the ability to lead investigations that identify and address root causes rather than short-term fixes.

You'll be someone who enjoys developing others, takes ownership of challenges and can make confident decisions in a fast-paced operational environment. Most importantly, you'll share our commitment to providing safe homes and excellent outcomes for customers.

The rest would be great too:

* Experience leading, coaching and developing operational or technical teams.
* Strong knowledge of damp and mould, condensation, building defects and building pathology, ideally gained within social housing or a similar property environment. You'll be naturally curious and driven to identify the root cause of issues rather than simply treating symptoms, ensuring long-term, sustainable solutions for customers.
* Understanding of relevant legislation, industry standards and best practice relating to damp and mould, including awareness of Awaab's Law and its impact on the housing sector.
* Experience managing customer complaints, complex cases and delivering customer-focused resolutions.
* Knowledge of housing disrepair, litigation or insurance claims relating to damp and mould would be advantageous.
* Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and changing service demands.
* Experience monitoring performance, managing KPIs and using data to drive improvement and inform decision-making.
* Confidence managing contractor performance and working collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of health and safety requirements and compliance obligations.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly to a wide range of audiences.
* A recognised professional qualification such as MCIOB or MRICS would be desirable.
* A commitment to Yorkshire Housing's values and an inclusive way of working.

* Salary: £45,685.50 per annum plus £2,000 car allowance
* Full-time, 35 hours per week
* 26 days annual leave (rising to 31 days with service) plus Bank Holidays
* Health cash plan including support towards prescriptions, eye tests and more
* Pension scheme with matched contributions up to 9%
* Retail discounts and lifestyle benefits
* Wellbeing support package including free fitness classes, access to My GP and counselling support

And plenty more besides!

**Now you're really interested?**

At YH, we're actively building a working environment that's inclusive as well as diverse, where everyone can contribute their best work and be themselves. We believe difference is what makes us stronger and recognise the importance of our teams reflecting the communities we serve, so we welcome and encourage candidates from all backgrounds for this role.

# Risk Consultant/Account Engineer (Property)

135833

**Working hours: This role is available on a part-time, job-share or full-time basis**

**Location: Home-Based, United Kingdom**

**Closing Date: 9th October 2026**

**The Opportunity:**

Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) is looking for an ambitious and customer focused Account Engineer to join our growing team.

This is an exciting opportunity to work with some of the UK's and world's leading organisations, helping them build resilience, reduce risk and protect critical assets. As a trusted adviser, you will influence risk management strategies, shape business decisions and deliver measurable value through Zurich's market leading risk engineering expertise.

You'll take ownership of a portfolio of key accounts, building long term customer relationships and coordinating complex risk engineering programmes. Working closely with customers, brokers, underwriters and business leaders, you'll balance technical excellence with commercial insight to deliver outstanding customer outcomes while supporting business growth.

The role is home based with regular UK travel and occasional international travel in support of global customer programmes.

Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of different ways, including part-time, flexible hours, job share, an element of working from home or compressed hours. This is because we want the best people for our roles, and we recognise that sometimes those people aren’t available full-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you may need.

**Why Join Us?**

At Zurich, our Account Engineers do far more than conduct surveys. They act as trusted consultants, helping customers make informed decisions, improve resilience and protect their businesses. In return, you'll gain exposure to complex risks, global organisations and exciting career development opportunities within one of the world's leading insurers.

**What you’ll be doing?**

As an Account Engineer, you will act as the trusted risk consultant for a portfolio of key customer accounts, spending approximately 60% of your time building embedded customer relationships and helping organisations achieve their risk management and resilience objectives.

You will develop and deliver customer service strategies that reduce loss, drive risk improvement and create measurable business value. Combining on-site and desktop assessments with strategic account management, you will coordinate complex risk engineering programmes, oversee service plans and stewardship reviews, and provide clear, actionable risk insight.

Working closely with customers, brokers, underwriters and internal stakeholders, you will drive completion of risk improvement actions, manage programme delivery through Zurich's global network and demonstrate the value of Zurich Resilience Solutions through benchmarking, reporting and service reviews.

You will also support business growth by identifying opportunities to expand our proposition, contributing to thought leadership and helping deliver the Property UK's financial objectives through revenue growth, strong budget management and operational efficiencies.

**What we’re looking for?**

We're seeking a commercially minded risk engineering professional with proven experience managing customer accounts and building trusted stakeholder relationships that deliver both risk improvement and business value.

You will have expertise in property loss prevention, including fire protection, business interruption and natural hazards, together with a strong understanding of recognised standards such as BS EN 12845, NFPA codes and FM Data Sheets. Strong communication, presentation, influencing and negotiation skills are essential, along with the ability to translate technical insight into practical customer solutions.

Success in this role requires a consultative approach, excellent commercial acumen and the ability to identify opportunities that support revenue growth while delivering exceptional customer outcomes. You will be comfortable engaging with senior customer contacts, brokers, underwriters and internal stakeholders.

You will be self motivated, committed to continuous professional development and passionate about sharing knowledge and supporting the development of others.

**What will you get in return?** 

Everyone’s different. That’s why at Zurich, we offer a wide range of employee benefits so our people can choose what fits them and their life. Our benefits provide real flexibility so our people can make considered choices and tailor their benefits throughout the year. Our benefits include 12% defined non-contributory pension scheme, annual company bonus, private medical insurance and the option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday, alongside a range of other flexible benefits

You can find out more about our wide range of employee benefits on our website.

**Who we are** 

At Zurich we aspire to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. Together, we’re creating a brighter future for our customers, our people and our planet.

With over 65,000 employees, you’ll feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company that is a long-standing player in the insurance industry.

We’ve made a promise to each other and every employee: to focus on sustainable impact, to care about each other’s wellbeing, to use our diverse expertise to be curious and optimistic and to develop the skills needed for our future.

If you’re interested in working in a dynamic and challenging environment where your creativity, ideas and contributions are recognised and rewarded, Zurich could be just the place for you. Be part of something great.

**Our culture** 

At Zurich, our strength comes from the diverse experiences, perspectives and talents of our people. Our goal is to create a workplace where every employee can flourish and where everyone feels valued, heard and respected.

Over a quarter of our employees are members of at least one of our inclusion communities (Employee Resource Groups), with groups focused on areas such as social mobility and cultural awareness. We’re proud to have received numerous industry awards recognising our diversity and inclusion policies and initiatives.

We’ve created an environment that places real importance on our people’s wellbeing from a physical, mental, social and financial perspective. We work with our wellbeing partners and industry experts to provide practical advice and access to a wide range of lifestyle support, alongside opportunities to learn, grow and develop the skills needed for the future.

We actively support our employees to give back to their communities through volunteering and charitable activity. Our charitable arm, Zurich Community Trust, is one of the longest‐established corporate trusts in the UK. Together, we’ve supported causes across the UK through grants and volunteering, contributing over £100 million in funding and volunteered time.

**Your application** 

We’re committed to treating all applicants fairly and with respect, irrespective of their actual or assumed background, sexual orientation, disability or any other protected characteristic.

As an inclusive employer we also want to ensure that all candidates feel comfortable and are able to perform at their best during the interview. You’ll have the opportunity to let us know of any reasonable adjustment or practical support needed when you apply.

We’d love it if you could submit your application online. If you require an alternative method of applying, please send an email to recruitment@uk.zurich.com

 

**So, make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.**
